groupContact.heading: MarkussenRacing
groupContact.excerpt:
Markussen Racing will run the 2022 season in the Danish TCR series, with Michael Markussen behind the wheel of a CUPRA Leon Competición. The team consists of 28 men and has existed in its current form since 2019, when the team then participated in the then king class – Mascot DTC.

A strong contender in the TCR Series

Michael Markussen's racer is a CUPRA Leon Competición: a new breed of racing car created with 3D printing technology, and powered by a 2.0 TSI 340 hp engine.

The car is built on advanced HP Multi Jet Fusion technology for better aerodynamics on the air intakes. In addition, the electric steering assists during the drive using software technology fine-tuned to racing standards.

Experts in color matching Bringing together the activities of MY GARAGE

The dream of gathering all activities around the motorsport team in one location was realized when the agreement with MY GARAGE became a reality. The premises here function both as a workshop for the team's TCR racers, as well as a showroom and office for the racing team.

Experts in color matching More than just a racing team

Although the intense minutes on the country's race tracks are Markussen Racing's primary focal point, the team offers much more than that. Behind the team are a number of sponsors who enable their development and daily operations. That is why Markussen Racing places a special value on networking and sponsor events.
groupContact.name: Michael Markussen

flexComponents.heading: MARKUSSEN RACING
flexComponents.column: The team consists of 25 dedicated members who all work to secure top positions in the Danish TCR series, where team owner Michael Markussen is behind the wheel. Markussen Racing is not only a professional team, but also a passionate family business where everyone behind the scenes has a deep personal investment in the entire project.

flexComponents.heading: A FAMILY TEAM SETTING NEW STANDARDS

repeaterSections.heading: Passion & power
repeaterSections.column: Markussen’s CUPRA Leon VZ is a strong proposition on the racing circuit, because the car was built using advanced 3D printing technology and is based on HP Multi Jet Fusion technology, which optimises the aerodynamics. The electric steering is both software-optimised and fine-tuned to racing standards to provide maximum precision during driving.

repeaterSections.heading: A dedicated family team
repeaterSections.column:
In addition to being a professional team, Markussen Racing is also a passionate family business. Racing driver Michael Markussen leads the way, but both his father, mother and sister play a crucial role behind the scenes. The entire family has therefore made as great a personal investment as a sporting one in the project.

Since 2020, Markussen Racing has been part of MY GARAGE, because they wanted a place that could help bring all their activities together under one roof.

acf_post.heading: MY GARAGE Sales strengthens the team with yet another experienced sales profile
acf_post.content:
After two decades of experience with Porsche, Morten Davidsen is now stepping through the doors on Wittrupvej as a new Sales Executive specialising in Porsche. With his personable manner and deep understanding of the German sports car brand, he brings many years of knowledge to his new role at MY GARAGE.

Morten began his career at Porsche in 2005. From 2005 to 2013 he worked at Porsche, and since then at one of Denmark’s leading leasing companies, where he has focused on, amongst other things, Porsche leasing. Today he can look back on 20 years with the iconic brand.

“Porsche is a big part of me. It’s a brand with enormous potential – not only as a sports car, but as a whole. You can take it to the track and set a brilliant lap time, but you can also pop out for bread rolls or drive to work on a Monday morning. Porsche can do it all, and that is also why I drive a Porsche 911 myself,” says Morten.

But it is not only the brand that Morten is familiar with. He already knows several of his new colleagues. In addition to Lars Bjørnbak, Morten has previously worked closely with Erkan Kilic, Lars Paugan, Christoffer Biel and Louise Rasmussen during his time in the Porsche group – and those relationships have had a positive effect on his start.

“I already know many of my new colleagues – and through both professional and private channels I have worked closely with the aftersales team at MY GARAGE, as many of my previous customers used Porsche Servicecenter Vejle. That gave me a good dialogue with both Paugan and Christoffer, and it means a great deal to me that I am now becoming part of a team with a high level of expertise and passion for the Porsche brand,” he explains.

Morten will be focused on sales and leasing – in particular of Porsche – and looks forward to the close collaboration between sales and service, which helps to ensure customers a good and efficient experience.

“Customers should feel that we are happy to go the extra mile for them. That mindset appeals to me. It is something I have always worked by – and which I know also permeates MY GARAGE,” Morten emphasises, and concludes:

“It is clear that the ambitions are high, but what I am most looking forward to is getting to know the customers and becoming part of a brand and a house that dares to think big.”

flexComponents.heading: Created from passion. Driven by precision. Refined by expertise.

flexComponents.column:
Since I was a child, cars have been a huge part of my life. I am drawn to the mechanics, the exclusivity, the design, and the breathtaking power of large engines. At my country estate, Rohden, near Stouby, we have for many years had a family garage and held events on the property for other motoring enthusiasts. It was here that the idea for MY GARAGE was born.

I wanted to create a gathering place for kindred spirits — whether that was car owners, motorcycle specialists, mechanics, salespeople, or any other kind of automotive connoisseur. During this time I spent many hours on the Jutland country roads, travelling between Rohden Gods, Vejle, and Horsens. I would often pass Egetæpper’s old spinning hall, which I had always admired in my childhood — there was something iconic about the cast dome rooftops.

In the summer of 2015 I took over the buildings, and the MY GARAGE adventure got under way in collaboration with CEO Lars Bjørnbak. The rest is history.

Anders Kirk Johansen Chairman & Founder

repeaterSections.heading: Our passion
repeaterSections.column: At MY GARAGE we are driven by a fascination for cars — not merely as machines, but as living narratives of craftsmanship, design, and precision. Every car we present has been selected with care and respect for its history and character. Our passion creates the framework for an experience that engages all the senses.

repeaterSections.heading: Our development
repeaterSections.column: Over more than 10 years we have shaped MY GARAGE into a place where cars, people, and experiences meet. We combine experience, expertise, and intuition to create an atmosphere in which quality, trust, and curiosity go hand in hand. Every encounter with us is designed to inspire and provide insight.

repeaterSections.heading: Our concept
repeaterSections.column: MY GARAGE is a universe where a passion for cars meets a lifestyle built on experiences, community, and shared values. Here it is not only about vehicles, but about curiosity, quality, and what binds people and marques together. Our partners, cars, and events form a whole, where every individual encounter creates inspiration, understanding, and joy — and where the car becomes a gateway to a larger universe of experiences and relationships. MY GARAGE invites you to explore, learn, and engage with a world where interest and passion are shared and developed.

repeaterSections.heading: Our mission
repeaterSections.column: Our goal is to be the mecca of the motoring world in Denmark. We want to be a place where cars become experiences and customers become part of a community. We want to make it easy for you to find your next car, but also to understand and appreciate it. MY GARAGE is about passion, quality, and that special moment when everything comes together.

groupContact.heading: CARGLASS
groupContact.excerpt:
Sometimes you are unlucky and get hit by a stone. However, in the vast majority of cases, stone chips can be repaired before they develop. Other times it requires a replacement of the entire window.

At Carglass, it is possible to have your window repaired both at Carglass at MY GARAGE or at any address using their mobile service. Regardless of which solution suits you and your situation best, you have the option of having both repairs and replacements carried out.

Intelligente forruder er intet problem for Carglass

More and more car models have assistant control systems or a sensor in the windscreen, which is important to take into account when replacing the windscreen.

It is the car manufacturer's instructions that determine whether a calibration is necessary. At Carglass, they can calibrate windscreens and sensors on the vast majority of models and brands. The calibration time varies from 30 minutes and up, depending on which type of sensor is in the windscreen.
After calibration, a test drive of the car may be necessary to ensure that everything is working correctly after the replacement and calibration.

Calibration of the windscreen is the adjustment that makes functions such as cruise control, rain sensor and automatic emergency braking work correctly after a windscreen change. If the safety measures in your car

does not work correctly, it can be dangerous, as you as a driver trust what your car tells you. Therefore, calibrating your windshield is of vital importance for your safety and that of your passengers

 Good advice for when the accident is over

If the accident happens one day and you are hit by a stone, then it is important to limit the damage. Therefore, Carglass recommends putting a piece of tape over the damage.
At the same time, it helps to ensure the best conditions for making the damage as neat and invisible as possible.

flexComponents.heading: Carglass
flexComponents.column: At Carglass, your car is in the hands of specialists who understand the importance of perfection down to the smallest detail. All types of car glass damage are repaired here – from the small stone chip that appears out of nowhere to the replacement of complete windscreens on modern premium cars. Carglass combines expertise, reassurance and service of the absolute highest standard, so you can focus on what matters most: enjoying your car.

repeaterSections.heading: Car glass repair
repeaterSections.column: Carglass offers rapid repair of stone chips with a focus on preventing cracks and minimising safety risks. Many repairs can be completed in as little as 30 minutes, and the work is carried out with full insurance coverage. You can rely on high quality and safety every time the car leaves the workshop.

repeaterSections.heading: Car glass replacement
repeaterSections.column: Carglass replaces all types of car windows with precision and safety in mind. The team also ensures recalibration of the car’s safety and driver assistance systems using advanced equipment covering all makes and models. The result is work carried out to OEM standard, so that both safety and quality are maintained.

acf_post.heading: Investing in cars
acf_post.content:
Over recent years, interest in investing in cars has grown, and if you have been bitten by the car bug, investing in a classic or exclusive car may be an interesting prospect. But what should you be aware of, and which cars are actually good investments?

What makes a car a good investment?

Not all cars appreciate in value. In fact, most cars depreciate from the moment they leave the showroom. However, certain cars – particularly classic cars, limited editions and cars from prestigious manufacturers – can increase significantly in value over time.

The key factors that influence a car’s investment potential include rarity, condition, provenance and the car’s historical significance. A well-maintained, original car with full service history will almost always be worth more than one that has been modified or neglected.

Classic cars as an investment

Classic cars have proven to be an attractive investment class over time. Iconic models from manufacturers such as Rolls-Royce, Porsche and Lotus have shown strong appreciation, particularly when kept in excellent condition.

However, it is important to remember that investing in classic cars requires knowledge, patience and the right storage conditions. Running costs, insurance and maintenance must all be factored into the equation.

Investing in modern luxury cars

Certain modern limited-edition cars can also be excellent investments. Cars produced in very limited numbers, or special editions from prestigious manufacturers, sometimes appreciate considerably in value shortly after purchase.

At MY GARAGE, we have extensive experience with exclusive and classic cars. Whether you are looking to purchase a car as an investment, or simply wish to enjoy driving an extraordinary vehicle, we can help you find exactly the right car.

Dallara was founded by Giampaolo Dallara, who, after working for Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini and De Tomaso, had a desire to create his own brand.

Dallara Stradale: The rediscovery of driving pleasure

Dallara has produced chassis and carbon fiber components for virtually all the well-known supercar brands and various racing cars worldwide: From the development of Formula 1 and Formula 3 cars to Indycars.

These skills have now been used to realize an ambitious project: to create their own car, where the main objective is to rediscover the true joy of driving on the track or the road.
This resulted in the first car under the Dallara Stradale name. A car that sums up everything Dallara has learned from working with customers and racing, and which gives the driver of the car the opportunity to rediscover the joy of sitting behind the wheel.

Build your Stradale according to your needs

A Morgan Plus Six is an open sports car with a soft top, and its design is as classic as its history. Morgan is a hand-built sports car, and the first Morgans were built as far back as 1909. British confidence and style with Morgan 6

Morgan is such an iconic marque and design that it has no need for complex model names. If you want four cylinders, it is the Plus Four; if you want six cylinders, it is the Plus Six. Whatever you choose, you get a modern sports car that, unlike any other car on the market, exudes British confidence and style.

acf_post.heading: Leasing a sports car
acf_post.content:
There are few things that match the feeling of sitting behind the wheel of a genuine sports car. Whether it is the sound, the performance or the design, a sports car is something you choose with your heart.

By leasing a sports car, you get the opportunity to realise that dream – without the large outlay associated with buying the car outright. And at MY GARAGE, you will find an impressive selection of exclusive sports cars available for leasing.

The freedom to drive your dream car

Leasing a sports car gives you access to cars that many people would otherwise never be able to afford to own. Whether you dream of a Porsche, a Lotus or another exclusive make, leasing makes it possible.

With a leasing agreement, you pay a fixed monthly amount and an initial payment, and you then have the car at your disposal for the agreed period. When the lease ends, you can simply return the car – or perhaps try something entirely new.

Why choose sports car leasing?

There are many good reasons to lease rather than buy when it comes to sports cars. Sports cars can depreciate quickly in value, and with leasing you avoid the risk of a large loss on the car’s value. At the same time, you get the opportunity to drive the latest models and upgrade to a new car more frequently.

Leasing also provides greater financial predictability, as you know exactly what your monthly costs will be throughout the lease period.

Exclusive sports cars for leasing at MY GARAGE

At MY GARAGE, we specialise in exclusive and unique cars. In our selection, you will find sports cars from some of the world’s most prestigious manufacturers – cars that provide an extraordinary driving experience every single time.

We offer bespoke leasing solutions tailored to your needs, so you can be sure of getting the best possible agreement.

Contact us today and find out more about our sports cars available for leasing. We are ready to help you find your dream car.

blogPost.title: Leasing with a low initial payment

seo.title: Leasing with a low initial payment - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: Leasing with a low initial payment - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: Leasing with a low initial payment
acf_post.content:
When you choose to lease a car, there will in most cases be an initial payment, also known as a first instalment, which must be paid before you take delivery of the car. This is therefore an expense you pay once, in addition to the recurring monthly payment.

Most people dream of keeping this initial payment as low as possible – but what actually determines the size of the initial payment?

The initial payment in leasing – what and why?

The initial payment represents a percentage of the car’s price and covers depreciation and any service costs. It is therefore the car’s value that determines the price of the initial payment, and in addition, the mileage limit may also have an impact depending on the specific leasing agreement.

The initial payment and the monthly instalment together make up the car’s total cost. This means that if you wish to have a lower initial payment, your monthly instalment will be increased as a result.

When you lease a car, its value will depreciate during the period in which you are using it. When the lease period ends and the car is to be sold on, you will therefore have paid for the depreciation of the car.

What determines the size of the initial payment in leasing?

The size of the initial payment in leasing depends on which car you choose. In addition, you can reduce the size of the initial payment by choosing to pay a higher monthly instalment instead. Whether you choose one option or the other, however, results in the same total value at the end of the lease period.

Where is it cheapest to lease a car?

Leasing prices can vary considerably, and it is therefore important to do thorough research if you are interested in finding the best price.

Why is there an initial payment on a lease?

There is an initial payment on a lease for several reasons. First and foremost, it is a cost to cover depreciation over the period during which you use the car. In addition, the initial payment can reduce the monthly costs, allowing you to pay a higher first instalment and have a lower monthly payment instead. Finally, the initial payment also helps to reduce the risk to the lessor should you choose to break the leasing contract or if the car sustains damage.

groupColumn.column:
Experience the driving pleasure of a fully electric sports car renowned for its impressive performance, featuring advanced batteries that deliver an exceptional electric range. The Taycan supports rapid charging and is equipped with 800-volt technology, enabling significantly shorter charging times. The interior of a Porsche Taycan is of the highest quality, and the luxurious materials contribute to creating a futuristic atmosphere. You are welcome to visit MY GARAGE and experience the model in person.

Which Porsche Taycan should you choose?

The word Taycan derives from an Oriental language and means “spirited young horse”. Porsche has developed several different variants of the Taycan, varying in performance, range and price range. The choice of Taycan depends on your specific preferences and personal driving style.

Porsche Taycan estate

This model is also known as the “Taycan Sport Turismo”. With its distinctive estate design, this Taycan variant is the most spacious. It is an excellent match for those who want a roomy car without compromising on performance, powerful motors and acceleration. You can expect a luxurious interior and exterior that combines sportiness with practicality.

Porsche Taycan S

A powerful electric car with strong performance and impressive acceleration. It is equipped with an electric motor on both the front and rear axle, providing all-wheel drive. It features Porsche’s characteristic design elements and benefits from 800-volt technology, which reduces charging time and enhances convenience.

Porsche Taycan GTS

Here the motor is more powerful compared to the Taycan S, resulting in higher performance and truly impressive acceleration. Its two motors are mounted on separate axles, providing all-wheel drive. It is equipped with high-tech features and luxurious materials. The GTS model features several unique design elements reflecting a sporting character. The Taycan GTS represents a middle ground between the Taycan S and the Taycan Turbo S.

Porsche Taycan Turbo S

This model is the top variant and is characterised by its lightning-fast acceleration times from 0–100 km/h in 2.8 seconds. It achieves sporting driving characteristics through two electric motors on separate axles, providing all-wheel drive. You get a comfortable driving experience with a luxurious interior made from high-quality materials and advanced technological features — a high-end electric car with luxury-class standards.

If you need tailored advice on your choice of Porsche Taycan, please contact one of our dedicated sales specialists. With their high level of expertise, they can guide you to find the car that suits your needs.

acf_post.heading: Leasing types
acf_post.content:
Choosing exactly the right car can be a challenging task with many considerations. Should you buy or lease? And if you decide to lease, which type of leasing is the right one for you?

On this page, we have gathered an overview of the different types of leasing so you can more easily find the solution that suits you best.

What types of leasing are there?

There are several different types of leasing, each with their own characteristics and advantages. Below you can read more about the most common leasing types.

Private leasing

Private leasing is when you, as a private individual, lease a car for a fixed period. You pay an initial instalment and a monthly payment, and at the end of the lease period you simply return the car. Private leasing is a popular choice for those who want to drive a new car without a large outlay.

Business leasing

Business leasing is leasing via a company. The leasing agreement is entered into by the company, which thereby gains a car for use by employees. Business leasing can be tax-advantageous, as the lease payments are a deductible business expense.

Operational leasing

With operational leasing, you rent the car for a fixed period, after which it is returned to the leasing company. A service agreement is typically included, covering maintenance and servicing costs.

Financial leasing

Financial leasing is a form of leasing in which you pay for the full value of the car over the lease period. At the end of the period, you often have the option to purchase the car at residual value.

Flex leasing

Flex leasing is a flexible form of leasing with no fixed lease period. You pay a monthly amount and can return the car whenever you wish, subject to a notice period.

Find the right leasing solution at MY GARAGE

At MY GARAGE, we offer a wide range of leasing solutions for exclusive and luxury cars. Whether you are looking for private leasing, business leasing or another type, we can help you find the perfect solution.

Contact us today and find out more about our leasing options.

groupColumn.column:
One of the truly special features of the Porsche Macan is its interior, which is defined by luxury and elegance, embodying Porsche’s philosophy of combining performance with comfort. From inside a Porsche Macan you sit elevated, with a full, unobstructed view of the road ahead. Here you can lean back in the sports car’s first-class materials, which make no compromise on quality or craftsmanship. You are welcome to visit MY GARAGE and experience the model in person.

Which Porsche Macan should you choose?

Porsche has developed several different variants of the Macan, so there is a model to suit your individual needs and personal preferences. Macan means tiger in Indonesian, and in keeping with that spirit, a Porsche Macan is characterised by its strength, elegance and athletic appearance.

Porsche Macan S

The Macan S sits between the standard model and the Macan Turbo. It offers a balance between performance and everyday practicality, without compromising on the powerful V6 engine, sporting driving characteristics and luxurious design.

Porsche Macan GTS

This model is a high-performance, sporty version in the Porsche Macan range, equipped with a V6 engine and tuned slightly more aggressively than the Macan S. It can accommodate the whole family and includes luxurious features and advanced technology.

Porsche Macan Turbo

If you want the top-of-the-range model with the most powerful engine and the most impressive performance in the Macan lineup, then the Turbo model is an excellent match. It distinguishes itself with unique design elements that emphasise a sporty and luxurious character.

Porsche Macan Electric

The groundbreaking fully electric Porsche Macan is the most sporting model in its class. It builds on Porsche’s heritage and features an even more impressive fast-charging capability than the Porsche Taycan, which was Porsche’s first fully electric car.

If you need tailored advice on your choice of Porsche Macan, please contact one of our dedicated sales specialists. With their high level of expertise, they can guide you to find the car that suits your needs.

We offer both sales and leasing of the Porsche Macan

If you wish to lease or purchase a Porsche Macan, please do not hesitate to contact us — we are happy to provide professional guidance. You can find prices for leasing and sales further down the page. You are also welcome to contact us if there is a specific Porsche Macan you are interested in — we can source all models.

acf_post.heading: Flexleasing
acf_post.content:
Flex Leasing

Flex Leasing

Flex leasing is a well-established form of car leasing that has become highly sought after in recent years. With flex leasing, you can lease a car for a shorter period than with traditional leasing, whilst still enjoying plenty of flexibility in your choice of vehicle. In this way, flex leasing makes it possible for you to drive the exclusive vehicles you have always dreamt of.

If you are unsure whether flex leasing is right for you, read on to learn more about what flex leasing is and how this form of leasing works with regard to insurance and the calculation of the vehicle’s tax.

What Is Flex Leasing?

Flex leasing is a form of car leasing in which you have the option to lease a car for a shorter period than with traditional leasing. Unlike traditional leasing, you only pay for the period during which your car is in use. The car is leased without registration tax, which is instead spread across the leasing period and paid monthly.

This form of leasing also offers a high degree of flexibility with respect to both your choice of vehicle and payment plan, so there is ample opportunity to choose from a range of models and makes.

Flex leasing also provides the opportunity to make personal customisations and modifications to the car, which can be a great advantage for those who dream of a truly unique and exclusive car that stands out from the crowd. We have plenty of those here at MY GARAGE, and we would very much like to welcome you to our garage, where you can get an overview of our extensive selection.

How Is the Vehicle Tax Calculated With Flex Leasing?

When you flex lease a car, you avoid paying the entire tax in one lump sum. The registration tax is spread over the leasing period, which typically spans between 12 and 36 months, and is paid in instalments each month.

The tax rate on the car under flex leasing is calculated based on the car’s age:

Cars aged 0–3 months:

Monthly tax rate of 2% of the total registration tax.

Cars aged 3–36 months:

Monthly tax rate of 1% of the total registration tax.

Cars aged 36+ months:

Monthly tax rate of 0.5% of the total registration tax.

How Does Insurance Work With Flex Leasing?

If you choose to flex lease a car, you will often face lower costs in connection with insurance and the monthly tax payment. It is normally the lessee’s responsibility to take out an insurance policy that covers the car and its passengers in the event of an accident, damage, and so forth.

In most cases, the lessee is also responsible for maintenance such as any repairs and service inspections.

At MY GARAGE, you will find a wide selection of luxury cars available for both sale and leasing. Whether you are looking for a supercar with the latest technology, a classic sports car, or an exclusive specialist vehicle, you can be sure to find it with us. If you have a particular model in mind that is not currently in our inventory, please do not hesitate to contact us, as we can almost always source the exact lease car you wish to drive. You can lease your dream car with us through our reputable leasing partner Selected Leasing or a leasing partner of your own choosing.

Are you unsure whether flex leasing is the right choice for you? You are very welcome to contact us on tel +45 69 13 39 11 or by email at info@mygarage.dk. We are very happy to share our knowledge in this area and provide you with professional guidance to bring you one step closer to your dream car.

seo.title: What does it cost to lease a car? - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: What does it cost to lease a car? - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: What does it cost to lease a car?
acf_post.content:
More and more people are considering private leasing when it is time for a new car. With leasing, you pay an initial instalment as well as a monthly payment, and you then have a clear overview of your fixed outgoings each month. In other words, you avoid unexpected expenses when you choose leasing over buying a car. But what does it cost, and is it worthwhile for you?

Private leasing: What costs are involved?

When you lease, the car is owned by someone other than you. In return, you pay a monthly amount for the right to use the car over a set period. You therefore need not worry about the large sum required to purchase the car outright. Instead, you pay an initial instalment, which is determined based on the particular car.

The initial instalment is paid before the car comes into your possession, and after that it is simply the monthly payment that you are responsible for. The initial instalment should not be regarded as a deposit, as it is not money you receive back at the end of the lease period.

Your monthly lease payment is like rent. It is also determined by the type and size of the car, the mileage allowance, and what else your lease agreement contains.

In principle, those are the only costs you have with leasing. As long as you do not exceed the mileage limit, you have a clear and fixed picture of what it costs to lease the car.

What does private leasing of a car cost?

It is impossible to give a clear answer as to what it costs to lease a car. This is because a number of factors come into play – including which car you are leasing, the number of kilometres in the contract, where you lease from, and how the leasing contract is structured with regard to additional costs.

You therefore have the initial instalment and the fixed monthly lease payment. In addition, there may be extra costs included in the leasing contract such as insurance and environmental duty, which also represent an additional payment for you as the lessee.

But can it truly be worthwhile to take out a private lease when there is both an initial instalment and a monthly payment?

If you want to calculate the total costs, you simply add the initial instalment to all the monthly payments – including fuel – and you will then get a clear picture of your outgoings.

Are you considering leasing a car?

Are you seriously considering leasing a car? Then it is a good idea to get an overview before you kick off the process.

Think about what your overall needs are. How long you wish to lease the car for, and how far you need to drive during that particular period? This gives you the best basis for narrowing down to offers that are actually relevant to you.

If private leasing is not quite the right solution for you, we at MY GARAGE also offer flex leasing, business leasing, split leasing and seasonal leasing.

If your usage is variable, and you struggle with the idea of restricting yourself on mileage and time, then purchasing a car may ultimately be more advantageous for you.

Gain financial certainty through private leasing

Buying a car involves significant costs such as the financing itself, servicing, depreciation and wear. All costs that are included in the monthly payment of your leasing agreement.

It is therefore difficult to judge whether it is better to own a car or to lease – it all depends on your driving patterns and your overall situation.

Many people who lease find that they achieve greater financial certainty, as they can draw up a clear budget where there is less risk of unexpected expenses, provided you do not exceed the mileage limit – which is your own responsibility.

It is therefore a matter of weighing up the advantages and disadvantages and, on that basis, finding the solution that best matches your needs. When you buy your own car, you are responsible for everything, but in return you experience no restrictions. When you lease a car, many people enjoy it because it is easy, convenient and reassuring.

In some cases, leasing will be the cheapest solution for you, and in other cases buying a car may make more financial sense. It is difficult to foresee what can happen during a lease period, but if you exceed the mileage limit or cause damage through your own fault, this will be assessed at the end of the lease period, and an additional charge may arise in this connection.

car.carComment:
Porsche 911 Turbo 3.3 (930) – 1979
A true sports car legend with raw character and iconic Porsche DNA.
The classic Porsche 911 Turbo 3.3 from 1979 is the epitome of the uncompromising sports car of the 70s. With its air-cooled boxer engine, wide fenders, distinctive rear spoiler and characteristic turbo power, it delivers a very special driving experience. A coveted classic that combines timeless design, motorsport history and impressive performance.

True Porsche expressionists will note that this is the legendary 3.3 Turbo on the visual details below
- Larger rear spoiler 
- Larger brakes that fill out the black centers on the Fuchs rims

The 3.3 Turbo, compared to the 3.0 Turbo, got a bigger engine, about 40hp extra which gave the impressive 300hp back in 1979. This was brought about by Porsche's skilled engineers in new mechanics like the intercooler, which cools the compressed intake air. At the same time, the brakes were upgraded with technology from Porsche's legendary 917 racing car. 

The 1979 model thus represents a further developed version of the original 930 Turbo – with more power, greater braking capacity and the characteristic, wide Turbo design.
It is a Porsche for the enthusiast who wants a true classic with history, personality and a very special presence on the road.

Finally, contact us for more history on this very fine Porsche 930 with Danish history and tax.

car.carComment:
Morgan Aero 8 - 2002 - Manual transmission

The Morgan Aero 8 is a sports car for the enthusiast who wants something completely different from the modern and digital. Hand-built in aluminium, powered by BMW's 4.4 liter V8 and combined with a manual gearbox, it delivers an analogue and uncompromising driving experience that only Morgan can create. Aero 8 is light, fast and characterful – a car that feels alive on the road.

The design is classic British with the long front, the organic lines and the distinctive headlights, which give the car an expression that stands out in any context. The cabin is characterized by craftsmanship: leather, wood and aluminum in a finish that only gets more beautiful with time.

Under the hood lies BMW's M62‑V8, known for its reliability, sound and power. Together with the manual gearbox and the low weight, you get a direct and unfiltered driving experience, where mechanical feedback and response are central. Aero 8 is a modern interpretation of the classic roadster - just with significantly more power.

An early example from 2002 with a manual transmission is a rarity today. The Aero 8 is already on its way to becoming a collector's favourite, and well-maintained cars with a proven track record are particularly sought after. This example appears as a car that has been cared for and appreciated by enthusiasts.

The price is incl. VAT & excl. charge.

post.title: MY GARAGE becomes Connecting Partner for McMurtry

seo.title: MY GARAGE becomes Connecting Partner for McMurtry - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: MY GARAGE becomes Connecting Partner for McMurtry - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: MY GARAGE becomes Connecting Partner for McMurtry
acf_post.content:
The British high-performance brand McMurtry has chosen MY GARAGE as its Connecting Partner in the Nordic region – a collaboration that marks the beginning of a new chapter for extreme innovation and groundbreaking automotive technology on Danish soil.

The partnership simultaneously underlines MY GARAGE’s position as the Nordic hub for some of the world’s most visionary automotive projects.

When uncompromising ambition is given free rein

McMurtry caused a global sensation when their electric model, the Spéirling, broke the track record at the Goodwood Festival of Speed, set a new record on the Top Gear test track and thereby set a new standard for what is possible in electric performance.

But McMurtry is more than a record holder.

The brand is proof of what happens when vision, engineering and uncompromising ambition are given free rein. With a focus on lightweight construction, extreme acceleration and radical rethinking, McMurtry represents a new era in electric motorsport and hyper-performance – and is now also part of the story at MY GARAGE.

“A collaboration with McMurtry sends a clear signal that MY GARAGE is the place where the most groundbreaking automotive projects and ideas belong. The brand represents the uncompromising, the extreme and the visionary – precisely the qualities we believe should drive the automotive world forward. For that reason, we are proud to be able to present McMurtry to our Nordic customers,” says Lars Bjørnbak, CEO at MY GARAGE.

Thomas Yates, Founder and CEO at McMurtry, adds:

“We only collaborate with partners who share our ambition to push boundaries and our values. MY GARAGE does just that. We are excited to introduce the McMurtry universe to the Nordic market in an environment that values innovation, passion, and technological courage.”

As Connecting Partner, MY GARAGE will serve as the link between Nordic customers and enthusiasts and McMurtry Automotive. The car can periodically be experienced at Wittrupvej.

About the brand

McMurtry Automotive was founded in 2016 by the renowned engineer Sir David McMurtry and a group of former Formula 1 engineers led by Thomas Yates.

The brand grew from a shared ambition to challenge conventions in motorsport and vehicle technology. Sir David wanted to create a new generation of small electric performance cars and saw in Yates and the talented team the technical depth and creative vision that could translate radical ideas into engineering reality. Together they set out to prove that small electric cars could outperform combustion engines in terms of performance, precision and driving pleasure.

Today, McMurtry is working on the McMurtry Spéirling PURE. PURE retains the compact size and groundbreaking fan system. It delivers 1,000 HP, accelerates from 0 to 60 mph (0–96 km/h) in 1.5 seconds. With a 100 kWh battery, rear-wheel drive and a safety structure built to 2018 FIA LMP1 standards, the car combines electric innovation with high performance and robust safety. No more than 100 examples will be produced.

The focus is on pure driving pleasure and groundbreaking engineering. The goal is to rewrite the rules of performance by introducing new technologies.

McMurtry aspires to be the world’s leading innovator in electric high-performance vehicles and fan-based aerodynamics. Beyond driving characteristics, the company is actively working to promote a more efficient and sustainable future through technology.

For further information, please contact:

Mette Læssøe, PR & Marketing Executive at MY GARAGE

Telephone: +45 69 133 951

E-mail: ml@mygarage.dk

Dallara has for over 40 years designed and produced some of the fastest and safest racing cars in the world. Dallara was founded by Giampaolo Dallara, who, after having worked for Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini, and De Tomaso, continued the dream of working with racing cars in his own company. Dallara has produced cars and carbon components for virtually all well-known supercar marques and various racing cars around the world.

These competences have now been applied to realise an ambitious project: to create their own car, the primary purpose of which is to rediscover the genuine joy of driving on the track or on the road. This resulted in the first car bearing the name Dallara. A car that summarises everything Dallara has learned from collaboration with customers and racing, and that gives the driver of the car the opportunity to enjoy the pleasure of driving for the sake of driving a racing car.

Specialising in classic, luxury, and specialist cars, MY GARAGE offers an attractive position for the sale of the Dallara Stradale. The house’s competences and knowledge of its customers will play a decisive role in the future sales development.

“We are proud of the collaboration with MY GARAGE. It is a well-established company that understands both the philosophy, the technology, and the craftsmanship behind our cars. We value their passion and love of cars and the personal relationship that we create with the people in the organisation. We look forward to a very successful partnership and to expanding the Dallara family in Denmark and other Scandinavian countries.” — Elena Leoni, Marketing & Communications Manager, Dallara.

Lars Bjørnbak, CEO of MY GARAGE, comments: “We are incredibly pleased and proud to become the Dallara importer. The distribution of Dallara is part of our strategy to become a motoring mecca for car enthusiasts throughout the Nordic region. With the Dallara distribution, we are one step closer to being able to offer customers the very best from the automotive world.”

In addition to the new collaboration with Dallara, MY GARAGE holds sales agencies for Morgan, McLaren, Kalmar, Rolls-Royce, and Lotus. The sales department consists of an experienced team of staff who always have between 50 and 100 exclusive cars in stock.

Lasse Kristensen, who will take responsibility for sales of Dallara, says: “With its unique history, Dallara is an exciting marque for MY GARAGE. I am pleased to be able to offer our Scandinavian customers such a special product as the Dallara Stradale.” The first customer-sold Dallara is already being built, and several others have expressed interest in the product. As this is a limited production run, the first Dallara models could also have investment potential for the future, with prices starting at 159,000 euro excl. VAT.

seo.title: The concept - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: The concept - MY GARAGE

flexComponents.column:
MY GARAGE is the place where passion and precision meet, and where every detail counts. Here enthusiasts, collectors and professionals come together in an environment that encompasses everything from rare classics to the latest supercars. With specialist workshops, welcoming partners, exclusive meeting and event facilities, more than 62,000 visitors per year and an atmosphere that celebrates exclusivity and car culture, we have created a community for those who do not merely see cars as transport, but as a lifestyle.

What we do

SALES: At MY GARAGE we collaborate with a selection of hand-picked partners who offer the sale and leasing of classic, specialist and luxury vehicles. In addition to our partners, our own sales department, SALES GARAGE, is also a permanent part of the house.

SERVICE: Service at MY GARAGE is an experience in itself. We make a virtue of our customer handling, and our maintenance and repair of vehicles is of absolutely world-class standard. We house authorised workshops for Porsche, Rolls-Royce, Formula Automobile and others.

STORAGE: We have 92 purpose-built storage units where we store vehicles for private customers under unique conditions in Denmark – theft-secured, with the option of ongoing service and insurance, in heated premises.

SOCIAL: MY GARAGE is a meeting place for all those who wish to be part of the broadest social community in the motoring world in Denmark. At MY GARAGE, meetings and events can be held that bring experiences, friendships and new knowledge – a gathering point for all those who have a passion for what the motoring world has to offer. Our ambition is to impress, entertain and upgrade our visitors.

Some things are worth immersing yourself in, investing more than is sensible, and losing all sense of time and place.

When the sound of pistons and combustion falls into rhythm, from mechanics executed to perfection, the heart skips a beat, and machine and human become one.

Together we create a community, with the best from the motoring world gathered under one roof

SALES – with expert advice SERVICE – with world-class engineering and customer care STORAGE – that does more than simply store and house SOCIAL – that brings people together and creates experiences for life

A sanctuary for motoring connoisseurs, Where mechanics are magicians, And works of art are lubricated with oil.

Let us take your passion to the next level.

Vision

To be the mecca of the motoring world in Denmark

Nowhere else will you find such a broad range of expertise and unique events, and that is how it will remain. MY GARAGE shall offer the very best in motor-driven vehicles in Denmark – service, quality and exclusivity – without losing our feet on the ground and the sense of community that has permeated the MY GARAGE adventure since day one.

Mission

To optimise and expand our repertoire of SALES, SERVICE, STORAGE & SOCIAL

By constantly challenging ourselves, we ensure a standard that keeps pace with the times. That is why our workshops’ equipment and knowledge are always up to date, and we make sure to have a selection of vehicles that lives up to our customers’ high expectations and our ambition to be the best in Denmark. Our premises have been under development and improvement since day one, and we continually strive to make the outstanding experience of visiting MY GARAGE a little closer to perfect.

Values

Community

MY GARAGE would not exist without our partners. It is by virtue of one another that we have a haven and can share experiences and inspiration. Everyone who is part of our community shares the same passion – and their anecdotes, sound advice and lively exchange of ideas are a permanent part of daily life.

Exclusivity

Exclusivity is a central part of the MY GARAGE community. All our partner brands are among the best in class – whether vintage or state of the art – and only the most skilled professionals become part of the house and form part of our daily life here. This is reflected in the high level of expertise and quality that we and our partners deliver.

Specialisation

At MY GARAGE we go into detail. Our partners are all experts in their field, with in-depth knowledge of their craft. This specialisation also permeates our events, all of which are niche-oriented and unique in their own way.

acf_post.heading: New Head of Sales will grow MY GARAGE Sales with passion and experience
acf_post.content:
When Troels Kær steps in at MY GARAGE on the 1st of June as the new Head of Sales, it is with both humility and a wealth of experience in the boot — and above all, an enormous passion for cars and the community they create.

“I have immense respect for what has been built at MY GARAGE. The brand, the place, and the history you can almost feel beneath the historic dome rooftops. I look forward to becoming part of that,” says Troels.

Troels’ career began far from the sound of high-octane engines, but the drive has always been there. Trained in the sale of paper and office supplies, he took over the family business at just 25 years of age and subsequently co-founded the office supplies chain Redoffice, which he sold in 2016. That was the starting pistol for a new direction: a personal relationship and a couple of investment cars opened the door to the automotive industry, where in 2019 he became part of Selected Car Group.

“It has been a wild journey — from 12 to 120 employees, from 900 cars to 5,500, and from one to six locations. I am proud to have been part of building something at that pace,” he says.

In Selected Car Group, Troels held commercial responsibility for investments in car funds and played an important role in building a new business line, dealer leasing, including the relationship with MY GARAGE itself. With his direct and unpretentious approach, he is accustomed to getting things moving — and that is precisely what he plans to do in his new role.

“MY GARAGE has enormous potential. It is not only about cars but about creating relationships and experiences. This place has something unique, and I look forward to actively using that in the sales work,” says Troels.

He will take responsibility for sales and the sales department and is tasked with driving growth — particularly within leasing, where he sees great potential.

“Without wanting to blow my own trumpet too much, I am a 100-metre champion in leasing,” he says with a smile, adding that it is an area he looks forward to strengthening in his new role.

But for Troels, it is not only about figures and growth. It is to a great extent also about people and passion.

“With marques such as Porsche, Morgan, Dallara, Lotus, Kalmar, and Corvette, I believe that MY GARAGE can become the house people go to for those special car marques with stories behind them — and where we as salespeople understand and share the customer’s passion. That is what I am passionate about.”

He brings with him new perspectives that will help to further develop the collaboration between the sales department and the other functions of the house.

“It may well be that we salespeople think we can walk on water, but without the other functions we have no product to sell. I very much look forward to contributing to that collaboration.”

With his many years of experience and his eye for both relationships and business, Troels approaches the task with great energy and enthusiasm.

“MY GARAGE does not use a scattergun approach. There is a strategy and an ambition that appeals to me enormously. I look forward to being part of that journey — and to creating even more movement beneath the dome rooftops on Wittrupvej.”

acf_post.heading: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars — A world-class business
acf_post.content:
Rolls-Royce’s success in 2023

The year 2023 was a time of extraordinary triumph for Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, with their sales performance and consistent excellence across the entire product range cementing a remarkable reality: record-high turnover driven by an undeniable level of interest and demand, culminating in 6,032 Rolls-Royce cars delivered globally in 2023 — more than ever before in their 119-year history.

Bespoke: Tailored personal perfection

Interest in individually customised orders continues to be experienced with a remarkable increase, underscoring the marque’s unique position in the market. Customer demand and rising expectations play a significant role in this success. All Rolls-Royce models continue to be hand-built in Goodwood, Great Britain, and every single car features bespoke customisations. The ultimate goal is not merely to create the best car, but to create the car that best expresses and represents its particular owner.

2023 was the year in which production of the Wraith and Dawn models was phased out, whilst the first customer deliveries of the first electric Rolls-Royce Spectre took place in the autumn. The younger segment in particular has shown growing interest, setting a clear course and laying a solid foundation for Rolls-Royce’s electric future.

Economic contribution to the United Kingdom’s overall economy

The year 2023 also marked the 20th anniversary of Rolls-Royce car production in Goodwood. As a milestone, a team of students from the London School of Economics conducted an independent study of the company’s total contribution to the United Kingdom’s economy. In addition to an annual contribution of more than £500 million, they have also created 2,500 jobs, of which 180 new positions were established during 2023 alone.

Future visions

Rolls-Royce has ambitious plans for the future, including a significant new investment focused on the modernisation and upgrading of their production facilities. These plans aim to improve and expand their unique capabilities for bespoke manufacturing, and to support the production of their forthcoming range of electric vehicles. This new investment will contribute to sustainability and will be almost invisible from ground level, like the original building. Furthermore, it will continue Rolls-Royce’s commitment to supporting the local wildlife and biodiversity.

acf_post.content:
Trackday is the highlight of the year. At MY GARAGE everything on offer is of the very highest standard in the automotive world – and the same applies to the events we hold. Here the ambitions are nothing short of world class. That is why MY GARAGE’s annual Trackday is also among the biggest and most exclusive highlights, where motoring connoisseurs from both home and abroad gather to celebrate their passion for the staggering power found under the bonnets of the many luxury and specialist vehicles.

An exclusive preview for specially invited guests. Trackday is a fantastic combination of racing, networking and above all socialising, where specially invited guests have the opportunity to bring their own track cars and to test-drive and experience models from a number of carefully selected marques and partners. As part of the day, we had the honour of hosting the European preview of the Lotus Emira and Evija, as well as presenting Aston Martin’s Valhalla, which is planned for production in 2023.

“Collaboration with the participating brands helps to complete the entire day, and had it not been for them, Trackday would not have been the same.” Says MY GARAGE’s Brand Manager Alexander Wisler, and continues: “I therefore wish to dedicate a special thank you to all our partners who contributed to this day.”

MY GARAGE ensures the optimal setting

Alexander Wisler is responsible for both the planning and execution of the event, and he himself is quite satisfied with how it went again this year and says: “This year we chose a new location for the event, to allow our guests to try their hand at a proper racing circuit that matches the capabilities of the cars. We therefore chose Jyllandsringen, which in addition to the circuit itself also completes the experience with its smart, newly built facilities. Our foremost task is to provide the right foundation for bringing together the finest and most exclusive brands in the industry in one place – exactly as we do with MY GARAGE as a motoring destination in its entirety.”

“We are incredibly proud to facilitate such a spectacular day in the world of motorsport, and we are already looking forward to repeating the success again next year.” He concludes.

post.title: Rolls-Royce strengthens its position in the Nordic region through new partnership in Copenhagen

seo.title: Rolls-Royce strengthens its position in the Nordic region through new partnership in Copenhagen - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: Rolls-Royce strengthens its position in the Nordic region through new partnership in Copenhagen - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: Rolls-Royce strengthens its position in the Nordic region through new partnership in Copenhagen
acf_post.content:
Today, at an event held at the British Embassy, it was announced that Jan Nygaard AS has been appointed as dealer and importer of Rolls-Royce in Denmark, with responsibility for Norway and Sweden.

“MY GARAGE has long desired a Rolls-Royce representation in the Copenhagen area and therefore views it extremely positively that Jan Nygaard, with Rolls-Royce Copenhagen, will from April become the official importer of Rolls-Royce in the Nordic region,” says Lars Bjørnbak, CEO of MY GARAGE.

At an early stage, Jan Nygaard AS reached out to MY GARAGE to open a conversation about how best to collaborate in servicing Rolls-Royce customers in the future. This has led to a close partnership that ensures current and future Rolls-Royce customers the best possible service through exclusive customer experiences and increased accessibility in the region, and that the combined competences of our two houses will create the foundation for an exciting future with the continued development of Rolls Royce in Denmark.

Michael Rasmussen, Sales Director at Jan Nygaard AS and Brand Director for Rolls-Royce Copenhagen, comments:

“We are proud to have been chosen as the official importer and dealer of Rolls-Royce in the Nordic region, and we look forward to working closely with MY GARAGE, who have already built strong customer relationships and a deep understanding of the brand.”

In January 2018, MY GARAGE became a Connecting Partner to Rolls-Royce Motor Cars and was thereby able to begin offering the sale and leasing of new and pre-owned Rolls-Royce to customers across the Nordic region. Furthermore, MY GARAGE was appointed as an authorised service partner under the name Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Service Vejle. After 7 years as a partner, numerous cars transacted, and growing demand east of the Great Belt, MY GARAGE is now entering into a partnership with Rolls-Royce Copenhagen.

“We are extremely pleased to continue strengthening Rolls-Royce’s position in the Nordic region, and we therefore look forward to supporting Rolls-Royce Copenhagen in their new role as importer, whilst we continue to service the luxury cars at our authorised Rolls-Royce workshop at MY GARAGE in Vejle,” says Lars Bjørnbak, CEO of MY GARAGE.

With a house that brings together professionals, car enthusiasts, and automotive connoisseurs, MY GARAGE has built a business characterised by uncompromising quality and service, as well as a community that embraces and celebrates the craftsmanship, exclusivity, and attention to detail of the Rolls-Royce brand. MY GARAGE looks forward to bringing its many years of experience from the collaboration with Rolls-Royce and its strong customer relationships to bear in the partnership with the forthcoming partner in Copenhagen.

Hearty congratulations to Jan Nygaard and Rolls-Royce Copenhagen. We look forward to continuing to create exclusive experiences for the Nordic region’s Rolls-Royce customers in close collaboration.

For further information, please contact:

Mette Læssøe, PR & Marketing Executive at MY GARAGE

Telephone: +45 69 133 951

E-mail: ml@mygarage.dk

acf_post.heading: FORMULA HAS SUCCESS AT MY GARAGE
acf_post.content:
The well-known company Formula Automobile has had an authorised Ferrari and Maserati service workshop at MY GARAGE since 2015. The central location in Jutland and the technical expertise of the staff have made Formula an attractive choice among car enthusiasts in Jutland and Funen.

Formula has expertise in both modern and classic Ferrari and Maserati. With the right technology and knowledge from specially trained technicians, Formula has the competencies to solve all challenges. The growing demand at Formula has resulted in the recruitment of yet another new technician, Jonas, who is currently being trained in the Italian supercars.

“We all have a burning passion for our work, just as customers have a burning passion for their cars. We therefore take great pride in servicing the world’s finest automotive marque, and no car leaves our workshop until we are completely satisfied with the work.” – Jens Roed, Formula Automobile

7 years of complimentary Ferrari service

Even though a Ferrari may not cover many kilometres per year, it still requires one annual service inspection. For all brand-new Ferraris, Ferrari offers complimentary service for the first 7 years when using an authorised service workshop. This service is offered by Formula at MY GARAGE.

“Not all customers think about the value of having received an annual service stamp. But we often find that it makes a significant difference when the car is sold on, and more owners are fortunately becoming aware of this. In addition, the annual service inspection also ensures that the car is always ready to deliver its maximum performance, even if it has been standing idle for an extended period.” – Jens Roed, Formula Automobile

Storage and service

The location at MY GARAGE makes it easy for customers at, amongst others, Gentlemens Garage, to have their car serviced at Formula. When the cars are stored in one of the units, customers do not need to think about transport or scheduling.

For those customers whose cars are stored at home or elsewhere, Formula offers a collection and delivery service that customers can make use of.

It is also expected that in future, more Danes will invest in a Ferrari or Maserati.

groupColumn.column:
Business leasing of a used car

Morgan is an iconic British marque that has been producing hand-built sports cars since 1909. The cars are produced by the family-owned Morgan Motor Company, located in Malvern Link, England. Until 2013, the company was led by the third generation of the family, but today the managing director has no direct connection to the Morgan family.

At MY GARAGE, we are proud to sell and service the luxurious and distinctive cars that Morgan has to offer. We already house respected British marques such as Rolls-Royce and Lotus, so bringing Morgan cars into the fold was a natural next step.

We have great enthusiasm for Morgan and always ensure that current and prospective Morgan owners receive competent and professional service, whether in connection with sales or servicing. At MY GARAGE, you will always find used Morgan cars in stock. If you cannot find the model you are dreaming of, please do not hesitate to contact us, so we can explore the possibilities of sourcing it for you.

The iconic Morgan marque

Approximately 850 of these hand-built sports cars are produced annually, and the design is world-famous for combining charisma, quality materials, craftsmanship, and performance. It is also this distinctive design that ensures Morgan’s unique position in the market.

As a customer with us, you can benefit from our central location and strong expertise in British craftsmanship, while also enjoying a gathering place for motoring connoisseurs. We also handle servicing in our workshop, using specialist tools and original test equipment.

Selected technicians at MY GARAGE are trained in accordance with Morgan’s specifications, enabling them to handle both new and used Morgan models.

A classic, cool, and retro car

At MY GARAGE, you have the option to either buy or lease Morgan cars, depending on what suits you best. We always do our utmost to put together the best agreement for you.

We achieve this by taking a professional approach to your enquiries and needs, which forms the foundation for working together to find the best solution.

Are you dreaming of a classic, cool, and retro design with a sporty and elegant expression? Then Morgan is exactly the right car for you.

With roots in motorsport and an uncompromising approach to engineering and quality, RML Group has earned a reputation as one of the most innovative and reliable players in the industry.

RML P39 – classic DNA, modern soul

One of RML's most sensational projects is the RML Short Wheelbase P39 – a unique tribute to classic GT icons from the 1960s, interpreted with modern technology, comfort and performance.

With hand-built aluminum bodywork, an atmospheric V12 engine and timeless Italian design, the P39 combines the best of two worlds: true classic beauty and uncompromising driving pleasure in a modern context. The car is only produced in a very limited number of copies, which makes it a collector's item in an absolutely special class.

acf_post.heading: ROLLS-ROYCE PRESENTS "THE RECIPE FOR SERENITY"
acf_post.content:
More than six years ago, a team of specialists, designers, and engineers began developing the new Rolls-Royce Ghost. As with the first Ghost, launched in 2009, the goal of the development was for the new Ghost to maintain its unique position within the Rolls-Royce model range.

Customer feedback on the first Ghost has guided the development team’s work and today forms the core elements of the new Ghost’s innovations and details. The customers’ wishes were clear: a car they could use even more; one that is more refined to be driven in and simultaneously even more joyful to drive oneself.

Advanced Planar Chassis System

In order to meet customers’ wish to improve the significant Rolls-Royce driver experience and driving dynamics, the Rolls-Royce engineers chose to build an entirely new platform. Drawing on the already existing models with all-wheel drive and all-wheel steering, a new undercarriage was created. With the new undercarriage and an advanced Planar Chassis System, incorporating intelligent camera and GPS technology among other features, the engineers achieved a more stable and composed ride. By means of camera technology, the system continuously adapts the suspension to the road’s course and surface, ensuring that the driving experience does not change with varying road surfaces. GPS data provides the system with information about the route and thereby ensures the optimal gear in advance of a bend, resulting in a more stable ride throughout the journey.

“The new undercarriage and its qualities are but one of the refinements that characterise Rolls-Royce. This applies not only to the new Ghost but throughout all the models. The fact that the developers take their cue from customers’ experiences and wishes is precisely what makes Rolls-Royce truly special. It is not merely about producing a new car; it is about building on the story of creating comfort and a driving experience in a class of its own.” – Alexander Wisler, Rolls-Royce Brand Manager MY GARAGE

Innovative acoustic landscape

The car’s enveloping and near-silent qualities were of paramount importance to customers of the first Ghost. The Rolls-Royce team of acoustic specialists therefore had an enormous influence on the development of the new Ghost. During the early testing phase, the acoustic team discovered that it was disorienting if all sound was removed. Their solution was to create a “whisper” — a soft undertone experienced by customers as a single, discreet note.

To achieve this, every individual component had to be tuned to a specific resonant frequency. This task encompassed the development of acoustically adapted sound-damping units for the seat frames and a series of apertures between the cabin and the large boot, to ensure that the troublesome low frequency matched the “undertone” of the new Ghost.

The head of the acoustic engineering team behind the new Ghost, Tom Davis-Reason, states the following: “The new Ghost’s exceptionally high acoustic quality is the result of significant engineering advances and great attention to detail, all underpinned by the marque’s patented aluminium platform. We could never have developed such an acoustically refined ambience with a steel platform.”

The marque’s experts called this comprehensive process “the recipe for serenity”.

The new Rolls-Royce Ghost is expected on the market in 2021.

If you are interested in learning more about the Rolls-Royce Ghost, please contact Sebastian Wichtrup by telephone on + 45 69 133 964 or by email at sw@mygarage.dk

The Emeya’s split rear spoiler is activated during dynamic driving and at high speeds, where it generates 215 kg of additional downforce, felt in the form of extreme driving stability and even better handling, and makes your motorsport heart beat faster every time you accelerate.

Active aerodynamics

The innovative active front grille, the Air Dam function, the rear diffuser, and the rear wing all contribute to ensuring optimal airflow in every driving mode. The result is superior control and an even longer range.

Led by light

The difference lies in the details. The Emeya’s dynamic lighting captures the attention of the driver, passengers, and passers-by alike. Adaptive high-beam technology improves visibility in low light while protecting oncoming drivers from glare.

flexComponents.heading: Encor
flexComponents.column: Encor is a new and groundbreaking design and reinterpretation house that takes the heritage of one of the automotive world’s greatest legends and elevates it into a new era. Drawing on Lotus’ original philosophy of lightness, purity and a purist driving experience, Encor works with respect for the classic while simultaneously renewing it with precision, craftsmanship and modern technology.

repeaterSections.heading: Reinterpretation of iconic classics
repeaterSections.column: At Encor, the focus is on preserving the soul of the car. Their first project, Encor Series 1, is a complete reinterpretation of the iconic Lotus Esprit Series 1 from 1975, preserved with the original design philosophy while also being created to meet today’s demands for performance and comfort.

repeaterSections.heading: Bespoke, hand-built quality
repeaterSections.column: The Encor Series 1 project is built on an advanced carbon fibre monocoque, improved chassis geometry and a refined balance between original form and modern construction. This means that every car – even when given modern technological upgrades – still feels like an authentic expression of Lotus’ original ideals.

repeaterSections.heading: Personal configuration and uniqueness
repeaterSections.column: With Encor, no two cars are alike. JOB APPLICANTS Upon receipt of an application and accompanying documents, the submitted material is read by the relevant manager with the purpose of responding to and assessing the content in relation to a defined role. Our lawful basis for processing your application is the balancing of legitimate interests.

The application and accompanying documents are shared internally with relevant individuals in the recruitment process and are not passed on to anyone outside the company.

The application and accompanying documents are retained until the right candidate has been found and the recruitment process is concluded. Thereafter, the application and accompanying documents will be deleted.

We process your information on the basis of our legitimate interest pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) of the General Data Protection Regulation, which is to assess your qualifications and competencies in relation to the advertised position.

In the case of unsolicited applications, the application and accompanying documents are retained for a maximum of 6 months, after which they are deleted.

If the application and accompanying documents are retained for more than 6 months, separate consent is obtained from the candidate.

Your consent is voluntary, and you may withdraw it at any time by contacting us. Please use the contact details above if you require further information.

VIDEO SURVEILLANCE As part of the security measures for our physical premises, there is video surveillance on site. We will at all times ensure that any use of video surveillance is carried out in accordance with the Television Surveillance Act.

In cases where video surveillance is used on roads, streets, squares or similar areas used for general public access, we will register this in the police register of CCTV cameras (POLCAM).

All recordings are retained for 30 days, after which they are deleted.

NEWSLETTERS

Purpose, legal basis and description of the processing:

When you subscribe to our newsletter, it is necessary to process your personal data. This includes your general personal data pursuant to Article 6 of the General Data Protection Regulation, including your name, email address and IP address. The purpose of the processing is to send our newsletter to you and to collect information about your use of newsletters with a view to future optimisation.

When we process your personal data for the purpose of sending our newsletter to you, this is done on the basis of your consent pursuant to Article 6(1)(a) of the General Data Protection Regulation, which you gave when subscribing to our newsletter.

When we collect information about your use of the newsletters in order to optimise them, this also takes place on the basis of your separate consent pursuant to Article 6(1)(a) of the General Data Protection Regulation. If you have given your consent to this, we may collect information about: when you opened the newsletter, where you clicked in the newsletter, what type of device you used to open the newsletter, and which region of the country you are in.

When you consent to newsletters as described above, your information is passed on to our supplier, who is responsible for distributing the newsletters and with whom we have entered into a data processing agreement.

You may withdraw your consent and unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time. You do this by clicking the “Unsubscribe from newsletter” link at the bottom of your most recent newsletter, or by contacting us using the contact details at the top of this page, with a message that you wish to unsubscribe from the newsletter.

Retention of your personal data:

We retain your personal data throughout the entire period during which you wish to receive our newsletter. If you withdraw your consent, you will no longer receive our newsletter with your chosen services, and your personal data included in our newsletter service will be deleted.

SECURITY We have implemented appropriate technical and organisational measures to guard against your information being accidentally or unlawfully deleted, published, lost, degraded or coming to the knowledge of unauthorised parties, being misused or otherwise processed in breach of applicable legislation.

DATA MINIMISATION We only collect, process and store the personal data that is necessary to fulfil our stated purposes. In addition, legislation may prescribe what type of data is necessary to collect and store for our business operations. The type and extent of personal data we process may also be determined by the need to fulfil a contract or another legal obligation.

DATA KEPT UP TO DATE As our service depends on your data being correct and up to date, we ask you to inform us of any relevant changes to your data. You may use the contact details above to notify us of any changes, and we will ensure your personal data is updated accordingly. If we ourselves become aware that data is incorrect, we will update the information and notify you accordingly.

DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION We make use of a number of third parties for the storage and processing of information, including suppliers of IT solutions. These parties process information solely on our behalf and may not use it for their own purposes. Where relevant, personal data may be disclosed to, for example, banks, debt collection agencies and auditors.

We use data processors/suppliers for the processing of personal data. We prioritise suppliers from the EU, as well as from third countries that the European Commission has approved in terms of their level of protection for personal data pursuant to Article 45 of the General Data Protection Regulation.

Disclosure of information to insecure third countries We also use certain data processors/suppliers in insecure third countries. Where the legislation of those third countries does not offer the same level of protection as the EU, we have enhanced obligations in protecting your data.

YOUR RIGHTS You have the right at any time to be informed of what data we process about you, where it originates from, and what we use it for. You may also be informed of how long we retain your personal data and who receives data about you, to the extent that we disclose data within Denmark and abroad.

Upon request, we can provide you with information about the data we process about you. However, access may be limited out of consideration for other persons’ privacy, trade secrets and intellectual property rights.

If you believe that the personal data we process about you is inaccurate, you have the right to have it corrected. You must contact us and inform us of the inaccuracies and how they can be corrected.

In some cases, we will have an obligation to delete your personal data. This applies, for example, if you withdraw a consent you have previously given. If you believe that your data is no longer necessary for the purpose for which we collected it, you may request that it be deleted. You may also contact us if you believe that your personal data is being processed in breach of applicable legislation or other legal obligations.

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Danish Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
