acf_post.heading: Why Martin drives from North Zealand to Vejle to have his Porsche serviced
acf_post.content:
Why Martin drives 247 km to have his Porsche serviced

“Being welcomed and made to feel at home means everything,” says Martin, who has been a regular customer at Porsche Servicecenter Vejle for the past 5 years.

When Martin makes the long drive from North Zealand to Vejle to have his Porsche serviced, it is partly because he feels welcome the moment he walks through the door.

The genuine warmth is what Martin remembers most clearly from his first visit to Porsche Servicecenter Vejle. His Porsche is not merely a means of transport – it is a lifestyle and a hobby, and the importance of having it serviced at an authorised workshop that he can always contact when something needs attention is absolutely essential in a busy daily life.

“It is thoroughly professional, and there is a great rapport,” says Martin, as he is served breakfast in the house’s lounge. From there he has the opportunity to work whilst his Porsche is in the best of hands in the workshop. When the car is ready, Martin is notified. As a former Vejle lad and footballer at Vejle Boldklub, Martin also often combines visits to the workshop with a quick trip to see his family.

It started with a recommendation

Martin often recommends the workshop to others in his network who drive Porsche, and it was actually in the same way that he himself first heard about the workshop:

“I heard about the workshop some time ago from a close contact who praised the house for its great versatility and for delivering a special experience for its customers.”

Martin himself also values the close relationship he feels you develop as a customer at Porsche Servicecenter Vejle.

“The relationship is built on more than just Porsche – it is professional, but very much personal too, and that matters.”

For most Porsche customers, the story of the brand plays a part, because it helps to bring Porsche owners together and contribute to a strong community.

Porsche Servicecenter Vejle’s workshop manager, Christoffer Biel, says:

“We see every single car that rolls into our workshop as an extension of our customers’ dreams, and that is why we deliver a service that matches their expectations. It is about the people and the passion for Porsche every single day when we come to work.” The workshop serves customers from across Denmark, Scandinavia and northern Germany.

Would you like to be among the first to hear the latest news from the workshop?

Sign up for Porsche Servicecenter Vejle’s newsletter here and stay continually updated with news from the workshop.

groupColumn.column:
One cannot speak of motorsport without mentioning Lotus. The distinctive British marque is particularly well known from Formula 1, where Lotus originally competed under the name Team Lotus. Lotus was founded in 1952 by engineers Colin Chapman and Colin Dare, who built the first cars for motorsport purposes. Only later could anyone other than racing drivers get their hands on the cars, which even on ordinary roads stand out with their characteristic forms taken straight from the racetrack. These are, therefore, cars that offer a driving experience beyond the ordinary.

The country’s only official Lotus dealer

While the first cars carried names such as Lotus 33, Lotus 49, and Lotus 91, the cars for the everyday consumer all received names beginning with E. Both the Lotus Elise, Lotus Exige, Lotus Evora, and Lotus Europa can be found on the roads. 2021 is also the final year in which you can purchase an Elise, Exige, and Evora brand new.

MY GARAGE is the importer and the country’s only official dealer and authorised service partner for Lotus. Here on this page you can keep up to date with when we have new Lotus cars available for sale. At MY GARAGE we are happy to help you find the model that suits you. We can notify you when we receive a new Lotus in stock, or we can reach out to some of the many dealers we work with if you have fallen for a particular Lotus model. Contact us today to find out more about the possibilities.

Who owns Lotus?

Lotus has a history of repeatedly changing ownership, and this is consequently something it is often remembered for to this day. From 1996 it was Proton that held ownership of the legendary marque, but in 2017 the rapidly advancing Chinese automotive manufacturer Zhejiang Geely Holding acquired a stake in Proton, and with it the British marque Lotus.

Where does Lotus originate from?

Lotus has left its own distinct mark on automotive history with its long and successful history in motorsport – including as a dominant marque in Formula 1. Lotus is originally a small British marque, which was acquired by Proton in 1996 when the previous owner Romano Artioli went bankrupt. In 2017, Chinese Zhejiang Geely Holding acquired a stake and became a co-owner of Lotus.

What is MY GARAGE?

groupColumn.column:
The Morgan Plus 8 is the predecessor to the Plus 6, and it is an eight-cylinder machine with both a power output and an aesthetic that belong to a bygone era. The Morgan Plus 8 is no longer in production, but you can still find a beautiful example in good condition with expert assistance from MYGARAGE. If you dream of the sound of a V8 engine and the classic British style and elegance that characterises Morgan, then a Morgan Plus 8 is the car for you.

Morgan Aero 8

The Morgan Aero 8 is the futuristic and aerodynamic cousin of the Plus 8, and it can be regarded as a Morgan supercar. The first Aero 8 models were produced in the year 2000, and this is a car that delivers performance on a par with the supercars of its era from manufacturers such as Porsche and Ferrari. At the same time, a Morgan Aero 8 offers a fantastic design that combines the iconic and quintessentially British tradition with a modern sports car look.

8 cylinders with Morgan and MYGARAGE

If you dream of the sound of 8 roaring cylinders combined with unparalleled style and heritage, we recommend you take a closer look at a Morgan Plus 8 or Morgan Aero 8. These are cars that each in their own way offer you a fantastic sports car and that quintessentially British sense of style. The design and driving experience differ between the two, so we suggest you contact us with a view to arranging a test drive.

MYGARAGE is your official Morgan dealer in Denmark, and we are ready to help you become the owner of a sublime Morgan. After your purchase, our technicians provide authorised servicing on your Morgan, so you are in safe hands every step of the way. Give your inner gentleman the space to flourish in an elegant and muscular Morgan Plus 8 or Aero 8.

The type and extent of personal data we process may also be determined by the need to fulfil a contract or another legal obligation.

DATA KEPT UP TO DATE As our service depends on your data being correct and up to date, we ask you to inform us of any relevant changes to your data. You may use the contact details above to notify us of any changes, and we will ensure your personal data is updated accordingly. If we ourselves become aware that data is incorrect, we will update the information and notify you accordingly.

DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION We make use of a number of third parties for the storage and processing of information, including suppliers of IT solutions. These parties process information solely on our behalf and may not use it for their own purposes. Where relevant, personal data may be disclosed to, for example, banks, debt collection agencies and auditors.

We use data processors/suppliers for the processing of personal data. We prioritise suppliers from the EU, as well as from third countries that the European Commission has approved in terms of their level of protection for personal data pursuant to Article 45 of the General Data Protection Regulation.

Disclosure of information to insecure third countries We also use certain data processors/suppliers in insecure third countries. Where the legislation of those third countries does not offer the same level of protection as the EU, we have enhanced obligations in protecting your data.

YOUR RIGHTS You have the right at any time to be informed of what data we process about you, where it originates from, and what we use it for. You may also be informed of how long we retain your personal data and who receives data about you, to the extent that we disclose data within Denmark and abroad.

Upon request, we can provide you with information about the data we process about you. However, access may be limited out of consideration for other persons’ privacy, trade secrets and intellectual property rights.

If you believe that the personal data we process about you is inaccurate, you have the right to have it corrected. You must contact us and inform us of the inaccuracies and how they can be corrected.

In some cases, we will have an obligation to delete your personal data. This applies, for example, if you withdraw a consent you have previously given. If you believe that your data is no longer necessary for the purpose for which we collected it, you may request that it be deleted. You may also contact us if you believe that your personal data is being processed in breach of applicable legislation or other legal obligations.

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Danish Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).

groupContact.excerpt:
The British high-performance brand, McMurtry, has chosen MY GARAGE as their Connecting Partner in the Nordics – a collaboration that marks the beginning of a new chapter for extreme innovation and ground-breaking car technology on Danish soil.

The collaboration also underlines MY GARAGE's position as the Nordic hub for some of the world's most visionary car projects.

When uncompromisingness gets free rein 

McMurtry made global headlines when their electric model, the Spéirling, broke the track record at the Goodwood Festival of Speed, set a new record on the Top Gear test track and in doing so set a new standard for what is possible in electric performance.

But McMurtry is more than a record holder.

The brand is proof of what happens when vision, engineering and uncompromisingness are given free rein. With a focus on light weight, extreme acceleration and radical innovation, McMurtry represents a new era in electric motorsport and hyper-performance – and now also part of the narrative at MY GARAGE.

As a Connecting partner, MY GARAGE must be the link between Nordic customers and enthusiasts and McMurtry Automotive.

Om brandet

McMurtry Automotive was founded in 2016 by renowned engineer Sir David McMurtry and a group of former Formula 1 engineers led by Thomas Yates.

The brand arose from a shared ambition to challenge the conventions of motorsport and vehicle technology. Sir David wanted to create a new generation of small electric performance cars and saw in Yates and the talented team the technical depth and creative vision that could turn radical ideas into engineering reality. Together, they set out to prove that small electric cars could surpass combustion engines in performance, precision and driving pleasure.

Today, McMurtry works at McMurtry Spéirling PURE. PURE retains the compact size and the ground-breaking fan system. It delivers 1,000 horsepower, goes from 0 to 60 mph (0–96 km/h) in 1.5 seconds. With a 100 kWh battery, rear-wheel drive and a safety structure built to 2018 FIA LMP1 standards, the car combines electric innovation with high performance and robust safety. A maximum of 100 copies will be produced.

The focus is on pure driving pleasure and pioneering engineering. The goal is to rewrite the rules for performance by introducing new technologies.

McMurtry wants to be the world's leading innovator in high-performance electric vehicles and fan-based aerodynamics. In addition to driving performance, the company is actively working to promote a more efficient and sustainable future through technology.

acf_post.heading: As a connecting partner to Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, we at MY GARAGE can now proudly convey the announcement of the new fully electric Rolls-Royce Spectre
acf_post.content:
A new era now begins for the most venerable and historic name in luxury and the automotive industry, Rolls-Royce Motor Cars. From 2030 onwards, Rolls-Royce will produce exclusively fully electric drivetrain models.

MY GARAGE Brand Manager Alexander Wisler says:

“Spectre marks a fundamental change in the long and revered history of Rolls-Royce. A new era has begun, and the renowned 12 cylinders meet their future. But where other marques must contend with the challenge of engine sound and driving experience, Rolls-Royce is aided by their vision of an eternally quiet and comfortable vehicle. I am convinced that Spectre will find its place in Denmark and appeal to an entirely new audience. We welcome both wholeheartedly.”

In a historic press release, Rolls-Royce Motor Cars announced that the first tests of their first fully electric car are under way.

Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Chief Executive Officer, Torsten Müller-Ötvös, states: “Today is the most significant day in Rolls-Royce Motor Cars’ history since the 4th of May 1904. On that date, our founders, Charles Rolls and Sir Henry Royce, met and agreed that together they would create ‘the best car in the world’.

“Using the most advanced technology available at that time and applying their remarkable engineering science, these two pioneers elevated early internal combustion engine cars from noisy, uncomfortable, and rudimentary forms of transport by setting an entirely new benchmark for distinction.

“The cars they created introduced the world to a true luxury experience and secured for Rolls-Royce the ultimate pre-eminent position it continues to occupy, unchallenged, to this day. The brand has continued to define the very best in internal combustion engines for more than a century.

“Today, 117 years later, I am proud to announce that Rolls-Royce is to begin the road testing programme for an extraordinary new product that will elevate the global electric vehicle revolution and create the first, and finest, super-luxury product of its type. This is not a prototype. It is the real thing, it is being tested in plain sight, and our customers will receive the first deliveries of the car in the fourth quarter of 2023.”

A PROPHECY FULFILLED “The use of electric motors is not a new concept for Rolls-Royce. Sir Henry Royce was fascinated by all things electrical, and his first venture, named F. H. Royce and Company, produced dynamos, electric crane motors, and bayonet-style patented bulbs. It was, however, Charles Rolls who truly prophesied an electrified future for cars. In April 1900 he experienced an early electric motor named Columbia and declared its electric drive to be ideal.

“Rolls said: ‘The electric car is perfectly silent and clean. There is no smell or vibration, and they should become very useful when permanent charging stations can be arranged. But at present I do not anticipate that they will be very useful — at any rate for many years to come.’ “Charles Rolls’ prophecy has been the subject of constant consideration in the marque’s Goodwood era. But we have not been satisfied that the available technology could support the Rolls-Royce experience. Until now. “Now is the time to change the course of luxury’s future.

“We embark upon this bold, new future with one enormous advantage: electric drivetrains are uniquely and perfectly suited to Rolls-Royces, more so than any other car marque. They are silent, refined, and generate torque almost instantaneously, whilst producing enormous power. That is what we at Rolls-Royce call ‘waftability’. “At Rolls-Royce, we have been experimenting with an electric drivetrain for some time. In 2011 we unveiled 102EX, a fully operational, fully electric Phantom. We followed this in 2016 with our fully electric 103EX, which represented our vision for the brand several decades into the future.”

A PROMISE KEPT “These extraordinary products generated enormous interest in electric drivetrains among our customers. They regarded it as the perfect fit for a Rolls-Royce. And during the past decade, I have repeatedly been asked: ‘When will Rolls-Royce go electric?’ And ‘When will you produce your first electric car?’ “I responded with an unequivocal promise: ‘Rolls-Royce will go electric from this decade onwards.’

Today I keep my word.”

A REMARKABLE UNDERTAKING “Charles Rolls’ prophecy and my promise have led us to a defining moment for the marque. Rolls-Royce has embarked upon a historic and unique undertaking, which today becomes a reality. Our designers and engineers have worked hard to bring us here: and we are now ready to commence road testing of the first fully electric Rolls-Royce in history. “This fundamental change in our drivetrain technology demands that we challenge every single aspect of the product before offering it to the most discerning and demanding individuals in the world: our Rolls-Royce customers.

“To achieve this, we have devised the most demanding testing programme in Rolls-Royce’s history. We will cover 2.5 million kilometres, which is to constitute a simulation of more than 400 years of average use for a Rolls-Royce. At the same time, we will travel to all four corners of the world to push this new car to its absolute limits.

“You will see these test cars on roads around the world. Look out for them — they will be conspicuous. They will be tested under all conditions and over all terrains on their 2.5-million-kilometre journey — which will literally accelerate Rolls-Royce into the future.”

FLEXIBLE ARCHITECTURE “In 2017 we debuted the Phantom and with it the brand’s proprietary aluminium architecture: a scalable and flexible space frame that would underpin all forthcoming Rolls-Royce cars. This unique technology, developed specifically for Rolls-Royce by Rolls-Royce and reserved exclusively for the brand’s use, was created to form the foundation not only for different internal combustion engine models, as it now does with the Cullinan and Ghost, but for models with entirely different drivetrains.

“To this end, our forthcoming electric car benefits from the Rolls-Royce architecture and therefore the extraordinary experience of a Rolls-Royce on the road. Free from any group platform sharing strategy, we were able to integrate our plans for an electric drivetrain into the architecture’s initial design and ensure that this extraordinary new product meets the extremely high expectations of our customers.”

A NEW NAME: A NEW LEGACY “This Rolls-Royce is the fulfilment of a prophecy, and it represents the honouring of a promise made many years ago. It is the beginning of a new legacy for our brand. In that spirit, we have decided upon an entirely new name for this car. A name as powerful and evocative as the others in the model range that have served us so perfectly over the past century — names such as Phantom, Ghost, and Wraith. It is a name that fits perfectly with the ethereal and otherworldly environment that we have reserved specifically for this moment: Spectre. Spectre is a name given to otherworldly beings synonymous with great power and presence; creatures of an alternative realm who make their presence felt through fleeting manifestation. A spectre compels the world to stop. It dominates the space it occupies. Just as quickly as it appears, it disappears again, leaving elation, energy, and intrigue in its wake.

“This name therefore matches the extraordinary Rolls-Royce we are announcing today — a car that makes its presence felt before disappearing into a world inaccessible to all but the few. As a British brand, we have chosen the British spelling, but the meaning is universal.”

AN EXTRAORDINARY FUTURE “With this new product, we announced our commitment to the full electrification of our entire product portfolio by 2030. At that point, Rolls-Royce will no longer be producing or selling internal combustion engine products.

“Spectre is the living fulfilment of Charles Rolls’ prophecy. My promise, made on behalf of Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, is kept. Now we begin a remarkable undertaking. I am proud that we will continue to drive the world’s most progressive and influential women and men into a brilliant, electrified future.”

acf_post.heading: The Dream Car

The journey to your dream car starts here

For most car lovers, the hunt for your dream car starts as an idea. Maybe a car you’ve seen in a movie, on the street or in your neighbor’s garage. It stands out – not just because of its design, but because it represents something bigger: freedom, passion and personal style.

At MY GARAGE, we know that it’s not just about finding a car. It’s about finding your car. And whether you dream of classic elegance, modern luxury or raw power, we’ll help you all the way, from the first thought until the car is ready in your driveway.

Beautiful cars with character and history

The dream car is rarely something you come across in the local car park – unless you live in Vejle. At MY GARAGE, you’ll find a curated selection of cars with character.

We sell exclusive models that stand out – both in terms of expression, technology and experience. These are cars that you remember: iconic classics, rare special models and modern luxury cars in an absolutely special class.

You can see some of the current models among our cars for sale, which are continuously updated with new options for those of you who dream bigger than standard.

Quality cars require quality in the process

When you are looking for a quality car, the entire process must be well thought out. That is why we offer a tailor-made solution, where we take care of everything from search and assessment to transport, documentation and registration. You don’t have to worry about paperwork, customs or technical details – we can handle that.

We work with a number of carefully selected partners, which makes it possible to ensure high quality in every step – from foreign purchase to Danish registration.

We thoroughly examine each car, assess its condition, history and any adaptation needs in relation to Danish regulations. This way, you not only get a great car, but also security and transparency throughout the entire process. If you want to delve into the process, you can read more about importing a car here.

How we find your dream car

The dream car is not something you will necessarily find tomorrow – but with the right partner, the journey can be both efficient and inspiring. The process will typically look like this:

  • We listen to your wishes and expectations for the car
  • We use our international network and partners to find the model of your dreams
  • We check the car’s condition, history and documentation
  • We handle everything from transport to customs and registration

You get a car that is ready to drive – without surprises

This process is tailored to you who do not compromise on quality or details.

Make your dream come true with MY GARAGE

Finding your dream car is not just about horsepower and design – it is about emotions. The right car makes you smile every time you get behind the wheel. It makes every drive an experience and every kilometer a pleasure.

At MY GARAGE, we are specialists in exclusive quality cars, and we know how to turn car dreams into reality. If you want to lease instead of own, we also offer luxury car leasing with flexible terms and full transparency.

It starts with a feeling. An idea. Something that feels right. We do the rest – from search to delivery with you in the driver’s seat all the way.

acf_post.heading: Finance Leasing
acf_post.content:
Have you considered leasing a car but are unsure what finance leasing entails? Finance leasing is one of several leasing options available and can be an excellent solution depending on your situation and needs.

On this page, we explain what finance leasing is and how it differs from other leasing types, so you can make a well-informed decision.

What is finance leasing?

Finance leasing is a form of leasing in which you essentially pay for the full value of the car over the lease period. Unlike operational leasing, where the car is returned to the leasing company at the end of the period, finance leasing typically gives you the option to purchase the car at its residual value when the lease ends.

With finance leasing, you pay an initial instalment followed by fixed monthly payments throughout the lease period. The monthly payment is determined by the car’s value, the lease period and the agreed residual value.

Finance leasing vs. operational leasing

The key difference between finance leasing and operational leasing lies in who bears the risk of the car’s residual value. With operational leasing, this risk sits with the leasing company, whereas with finance leasing it lies with you as the lessee.

With operational leasing, a service agreement is typically included, whereas with finance leasing you are usually responsible for service and maintenance costs yourself.

Finance leasing for businesses

Finance leasing is particularly popular among businesses, as the lease payments can often be deducted as a business expense. In addition, the car can be shown on the company’s balance sheet, which may be advantageous in certain situations.

acf_post.heading: Private leasing
acf_post.content:
Are you looking for a new car but would prefer to avoid the large outgoings associated with purchase, repair and maintenance? Then private leasing may well be exactly the right choice for you. Or perhaps you are a keen motoring enthusiast who has set your sights on a new dream car? With private car leasing, there is ample opportunity to drive the very cars you have been longing for, and private leasing is an excellent way to explore a wide range of exciting vehicles.

On this page, we delve into the subject, including the costs associated with private leasing and the many advantages of leasing your car.

What is private leasing?

Private leasing is when you, as a private individual, take out a long-term lease on a car – as opposed to leasing through your employer. The only difference between private and business leasing is whether you are leasing the car for personal use or whether it is the company that is leasing the car for use by an employee.

When you privately lease a car, you obtain the right to use the car for the agreed lease period. When leasing a car for personal use, you pay an initial deposit, and thereafter a monthly amount is paid throughout the lease period. You can enter into various leasing agreements, which may differ depending on, among other things, the type of car and where you choose to lease.

The advantages of privately leasing a car

Although leasing is often a matter of personal preference, there are many advantages to privately leasing a car.

Below we have gathered some of the benefits of privately leasing your car.

Lower monthly costs

The option to change your car at regular intervals

No unexpected expenses

A flexible solution

What does it cost to lease a car privately?

The cost of privately leasing a car depends on several factors. These include the make of the car, the lease period, the model and specification, the mileage allowance, and whether service, inspections and maintenance are included in the leasing agreement. Leasing agreements are not the same across all companies, and therefore prices and conditions differ depending on the agreement.

You can expect to pay a fixed monthly amount throughout the entire lease period, and the monthly payment also varies according to the same factors as explained above. At MY GARAGE, you can view the monthly payment on the individual car’s listing.

A broad selection of exclusive cars for leasing at MY GARAGE

Are you interested in an older classic sports car, a specialist car or a supercar with the latest technology wrapped in an extravagant design? In our selection, we have all of that and more. You will find makes such as Rolls-Royce, Lotus, Porsche and Mercedes, for example.

At MY GARAGE there are endless possibilities when it comes to cars and other luxury vehicles, and within the selection you will certainly be able to find a car that can meet all your needs.

Should you not find the model you are looking for in our range, you are very welcome to contact us, as we can almost always source the exact leasing car you have in mind.

Are you interested in learning more about our bespoke leasing solutions?

At MY GARAGE you can begin to realise your dream of privately leasing a car. acf_post.heading: Insurance for Classic Cars
acf_post.content:
Owning a classic car is something truly special. It is not merely a means of transport – it is a piece of automotive history, a passion project and often a considerable investment. Precisely for this reason, it is essential to have the right insurance in place.

Why is classic car insurance different?

Standard car insurance is designed for everyday vehicles that depreciate over time. A classic car is different. With proper care and maintenance, a classic car can actually increase in value, and this must be reflected in the insurance policy.

Classic car insurance typically takes into account the agreed value of the car rather than its market value. This means you and the insurer agree on the car’s value in advance, so you know exactly what you will receive in the event of a total loss.

What should a classic car insurance policy cover?

When insuring a classic car, there are several important aspects to consider. These include agreed value coverage, so you are not underinsured, as well as coverage for restoration costs if the car is damaged. It is also worth considering whether the policy includes roadside assistance and coverage for participation in shows and events.

Limited mileage and storage

Many classic car insurance policies offer favourable premiums in exchange for a limited annual mileage, as classic cars are typically not used as everyday vehicles. Proper storage is also important – both for the car’s condition and for your insurance.

Find the right solution for your classic car

At MY GARAGE, we have extensive experience with exclusive and classic cars. We can advise you on the best way to protect your investment – whether through insurance, storage or regular maintenance.

Contact us today and let us help you take the best possible care of your classic car.

acf_post.heading: KALMAR Automotive appoints MY GARAGE as exclusive dealer in Scandinavia
acf_post.content:
KALMAR Automotive builds bespoke vehicles that can be tailored to various purposes. They bring together decades of experience from the automotive and motorsport industries, combined with classic design and pioneering engineering, to offer unique products. Every car has its own story and is crafted to perfection.

With a clear vision of offering the very best in the automotive world, MY GARAGE is the natural partner to handle sales in Scandinavia. The house already encompasses a wide range of partners, all of whom are experts in their respective fields. The collaboration between KALMAR Automotive and MY GARAGE is therefore far from coincidental.

“We have been looking for the right Scandinavian partner to manage sales in the Nordic region, and the choice of MY GARAGE was entirely deliberate. We have long been watching from the sidelines and have seen how the house has grown into an entity that offers precisely the framework, experience and expertise we seek in a sales partner.” – states Jan Kalmar, owner and founder of KALMAR Automotive.

With a specialisation in classic, luxury and bespoke vehicles, MY GARAGE offers an attractive platform for the sale of KALMAR Automotive. The house’s competencies and knowledge of its customers will play a decisive role in the future sales development.

Lars Bjørnbak, Director at MY GARAGE, states: “At MY GARAGE we are proud to take on the role of Scandinavian dealer of KALMAR Automotive. When Danish craftsmanship succeeds in creating such a unique product of exceptional quality, I have absolutely no doubt that they should be part of MY GARAGE.”

The first Danish car of the KALMAR Automotive marque is a tribute to Tom Kristensen and his first Le Mans victory. This gave rise to the model name 7-97, as Tom was behind the wheel of a Porsche WSC-95 in 1997 with the number 7. The 7-97 model consists of components from Porsche models internally known as the 964 and 993, whilst featuring a bespoke design inspired by the 911 models from the late 1960s. The first KALMAR will take its place in Tom Kristensen’s private collection, which already includes several models with reference to his Le Mans career.

In addition to the new collaboration with KALMAR Automotive, MY GARAGE holds sales agencies for McLaren, Rolls-Royce and Lotus, as well as Denmark’s largest authorised Porsche service centre. The sales department comprises an experienced team of staff, who always have between 50 and 100 exclusive vehicles in stock.

Erkan Kilic, who will be responsible for the sale of KALMAR at MY GARAGE, says: “After many years of experience with Porsche, I am now delighted to be able to offer our Scandinavian customers a product as refined and special as KALMAR. Configuring and building a KALMAR is, for the future owners, a unique opportunity to put their own personal stamp on the car.”

Such a process deals with much more than contractual relationships and ownership – it is a close relationship with both the car and not least the team behind the conversion.

A dedicated team hand builds your car

A KALMAR is not built on a production line – on the contrary, it is hand-built and closely monitored by a so-called 'Car Chef', who follows the process from donor car to completed KALMAR. The reason for this is that KALMAR Automotive believes that personal service is essential for the creation of the customer's automotive dream.

At the same time, the essential knowledge that the assigned Car Chef acquires during the process helps to strengthen both the actual production and performance.

Built for road, track and off-road

The essence of race lies in the heart of everyone in the team at KALMAR Automotive. For the same reason, the workshop is also located inside an FIA-approved race track in north-eastern Scandinavia. The facilities include both a traditional racetrack, off-road and dirt track, enabling the cars to be tested in their very element.

As a customer, you are also invited to participate in the ongoing tests of the car during the conversion process. After completion and final acceptance of the car, you are also always welcome to visit the track as you wish.

MY GARAGE handles the sale of KALMAR, with the greatest interest. The way of thinking fits like hand in glove with the concept of the house. Taking something existing, making it better, giving it new life and sharing it.
At the same time, MY GARAGE has extensive experience with classic Porsches, which benefits the process from finding the right donor car to handing over the completed KALMAR.

acf_post.heading: The partners at MY GARAGE create internal synergies
acf_post.content:
The partners’ extensive expertise

With the partners’ extensive expertise, they strive to create outstanding experiences for customers. Together they are able to handle every phase of the process under one roof, thereby enabling an outstanding customer experience, because the customer only needs to relate to the MY GARAGE universe and the house’s partners from start to finish. The customer is thus assured that all work is carried out in-house and handled by some of the country’s most skilled professionals within their respective fields.

Wrapit receives this Ferrari 458 and simultaneously enters into a dialogue with the customer, conducting a cosmetic assessment of the car. A plan is drawn up here for rectification and handling, as well as which partners need to be involved. The customer is part of the process from start to finish and all decisions are made on the basis of the customer’s requirements and wishes. The partners involved each contribute their expertise and experience to achieve the best possible result. In this case, the focus has been on optimising the car’s appearance and rectifying deficiencies with the best possible outcome in mind.

The partners involved

At Formula Automobile they are experts in Ferrari and Maserati, and the company is built on the foundation of sharing the passion for precisely these two car brands. Servicing these respected car marques is a responsibility, and technicians therefore undergo brand-specific training and courses to continuously maintain their expert knowledge. They are therefore entirely the right people to ensure the removal of the parts on this Ferrari 458, so that it is ready for the next step in the process. It is of course also here that the car is reassembled to ensure all parts are correctly fitted.

With a full 24 years of experience in automotive paint refinishing, AH Autolak places quality first and foremost. Next comes living up to the customer’s requirements and expectations, which their state-of-the-art workshop gives them every opportunity to do. The workshop is equipped with modern spray booths, infrared drying, and room ventilation, ensuring they are able to handle all types of paint finishing to the highest quality, as well as the repair of damage. On this Ferrari 458 there were several areas of the car where the wrap had been damaged, but as it was not deemed necessary to sand, prime, and paint the entire car, this has only been done on specifically selected areas. They have sanded down the entire front and the panels of the car, applied primer, and finally the car has been painted. The important part of the process here is to ensure that the areas of the car that are treated match the rest of the car that has not been repainted.

Following this, the car has received a polish, interior care, window polish, tyre dressing, plastic colouring, and touch-up work at Carcare By Oxholm. Although the car from 2012 has covered some kilometres and therefore has a degree of patina, they can with the right products, quality, and expertise give the car the best possible treatment and ensure it is prepared with respect for the car’s model and condition. Carcare By Oxholm is one of the country’s most skilled specialists in, among other things, paint correction, interior cleaning, and surface protection, which means they have the necessary and appropriate insight to carry out the work.

Finally, the car has had the removed parts refitted and is now ready for the last stage in the process. It receives a complete transparent Paint Protection Film applied at Wrapit. The PPF protects the paint against scratches and stone chips and has self-healing as well as super-hydrophobic properties. It is an excellent way to protect your car and give it the best possible conditions with regard to maintenance and daily use. Wrapit has over 20 years of experience and is among the country’s best at carrying out wrap work. With a fine blend of finesse, attention to detail, and above all good craftsmanship, they are entirely the right choice for carrying out this task.

Strong partnerships

For us, this story is a picture of the strong partnerships that exist in-house and that the universe is built from experts and highly skilled professionals. Together they help to set the right professional parameters and create an exclusive, holistic experience for the customers who come to the house. The photographs show every stage in the process as well as the finished result, which we are incredibly proud to be able to present.

seo.opengraphTitle: Morgan appoints MY GARAGE to represent the Morgan brand in Denmark - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: Morgan appoints MY GARAGE to represent the Morgan brand in Denmark
acf_post.content:
Another British and exclusive car marque will be found at MY GARAGE during 2021: Morgan.

The house already represents British marques such as Rolls-Royce, McLaren, and Lotus, so when Morgan needed to appoint a new partner to represent Morgan in Denmark, the choice fell quite naturally on MY GARAGE.

On this, Marcus Blake, Chief Sales Officer, Morgan Motor Company, states: “We are delighted to welcome MY GARAGE to the Morgan dealership network. The team at MY GARAGE have shown a real enthusiasm for the Morgan brand, and with extensive experience working with other luxury and sports car brands, we are confident they are best placed to help establish Morgan in Denmark. Their facility is a fantastic destination, and one we know current and future Morgan owners will get a fantastic experience at. We wish the best of luck to MY GARAGE and the team and look forward to a prosperous partnership with them.”

With a central location in Denmark, a strong track record in British craftsmanship, and a meeting place for motoring enthusiasts, MY GARAGE is in an advantageous position to represent and elevate Morgan to new heights in Denmark. On this, Lars Bjørnbak, CEO, MY GARAGE, comments: “As part of our strategy of housing marques with growth potential in Denmark, I am pleased to be able to announce the collaboration with Morgan. We have come a long way in our long-term plan to represent multiple marques in Denmark, but the new collaboration with Morgan also shows that there are still more marques out there that need a strong partner in the country.”

With a Morgan population in Denmark that is predominantly older, the Morgan sales representative, Lasse Kristensen, is pleased that the first factory-new Morgan cars are already in the order book: “I am convinced that Morgan has its rightful place in Denmark — and the first orders have confirmed this for me. We have a clear strategy to renew the brand’s signal value: Morgan should be thought of as ‘Classic Cool’ — retro design with a sporty and elegant expression.”

Sales of Morgan have commenced and orders for both new and pre-owned cars are already being fulfilled. Servicing can likewise be handled from the workshop with specialist tools and original test equipment. Selected technicians at MY GARAGE will be trained in accordance with Morgan’s specifications so that they are able to take care of both new and pre-owned Morgan models.

Morgan Motor Company is a British car manufacturer offering hand-built sports cars — located in Malvern Link, England. The world-famous Morgan cars offer a unique combination of charisma, quality materials, craftsmanship, and performance. Morgan has been hand-building traditional British sports cars since 1909, occupying a unique position in the market. In March 2019, the private equity fund Investindustrial invested in Morgan Motor Company, taking a majority shareholding. This investment secures Morgan Motor Company a long-term future, continuing to build cars in England. The Morgan family retains a stake in the company and will going forward work together with Investindustrial on the board. Morgan Motor Company produces approximately 850 cars per year, of which approximately 70% are exported. The model range, primarily comprising the Plus Four and Plus Six, is sold through 60 official dealers in 32 countries.

acf_post.heading: KALMAR Automotive takes recycling to a new level
acf_post.content:
As a manufacturer of bespoke sports cars and tailored vehicles for your next adventure, KALMAR Automotive has now entered a new era with the debut of its first EV conversion.

The unique KALMAR 7-97 E-volt is built on sustainable technologies and elevates recycling to a new level through its ‘Evergreen’ philosophy. Based on the 964 generation of the 911, it is powered by a high-performance electric drivetrain that has been recycled and reengineered from a Tesla Model S. KALMAR has succeeded in reusing several of the raw materials, and the aluminium has therefore been recast from the donor vehicle, with the glass reshaped from the original.

With the new plant-fibre body, which is new for 2024, the E-volt has an overall kerb weight equal to that of the original 964 Turbo, with which it also shares its external dimensions. This revised body has resulted in an improved aerodynamic balance compared to the original, and the proprietary glass design has been developed to increase efficiency by reducing aerodynamic drag whilst simultaneously reducing wind noise and aerodynamic lift.

Timeless design and groundbreaking technology

In typical KALMAR fashion, everything has of course been improved from the original Tesla Model S drivetrain with which the 7-97 E-volt is equipped. To ensure the drivetrain’s full potential is unlocked, the associated systems are optimised, resulting in an equivalent output of more than 450 HP. By way of comparison, that is more than even the most powerful iteration of the road-going 964 ever built.

The motor is furthermore positioned at the rear, counterbalanced by the primary battery situated at the front axle, meaning the famous 911 weight distribution is preserved. An electric vacuum pump drives the braking system, the electric power steering and the electric climate control systems.

Jan Kalmar, founder of KALMAR Automotive, explains how the inspiration and idea for creating an EV version came from customers. “It had to be more than simply fitting an EV motor into a 911.” Therefore, consideration was also given to how far its green credentials could be taken. The use of an existing car had to be taken further, resulting in several components being recast, the glass being reshaped and the use of technologies such as flax fibres, which produce lower CO2 in their manufacture than carbon fibre. The donor vehicle for the first 7-97 E-volt was an engineless Porsche 964, which KALMAR Automotive has given a new ‘green’ lease of life.

When you set eyes on the Lotus Emira, there is no doubt – this sports car commands attention with its utterly accomplished design. It performs and draws admiration both at speed and when stationary. The car’s centre of gravity has been lowered to achieve complete stability and control in every corner. You will enjoy a driving experience in which you are physically very close to the ground, yet mentally you will soar to the highest altitudes and experience an adrenaline rush you will not soon forget.

Built with the racetrack in mind

With a powerful combustion engine you achieve maximum traction and impressive acceleration, making the Lotus Emira the perfect sports car. Even in wet conditions it gives you full steering control over your drive. You can choose between a four-cylinder turbocharged engine capable of reaching a top speed of 275 km/h, or a V6 supercharged unit if you want the most powerful model. The Lotus Emira is designed for track use with its powerful engines and lightweight construction. The Emira GT4 model is designed exclusively for track use and is built to perform on the racetrack.

Interior developed for everyday use

You will be met by a comfortable and luxurious interior experience that extends to an entirely new level. Here you as the driver are in control and have everything you need within reach. The gear lever is positioned further forward, in close proximity to the steering wheel, so you can change gear quickly and efficiently. It is possible to choose either a manual or automatic gearbox for the Lotus Emira. Part of the interior is inspired by the design of fighter jets, which also serves the functional purpose of meaning you do not need to take your eyes off the road when operating the car’s precise tactile controls. Despite the Emira being a top-class sports car, additional storage space has been incorporated for everyday needs.

Extraordinary audio experience

If you love quality sound, you will find it here. The Lotus Emira is equipped with advanced technologies to achieve the most optimal audio quality. The sound system envelops both driver and passenger in an intense, close, and balanced audio atmosphere, specially developed for Lotus by the innovative British loudspeaker manufacturers KEF.

acf_post.heading: MY GARAGE becomes Danish dealer of Corvette
acf_post.content:
We can today announce that MY GARAGE has been appointed as an authorised dealer and service partner of Corvette in Denmark.

After five years without official Corvette representation in Denmark, MY GARAGE is now stepping in as the only Danish authorised dealer and service partner for the brand. Hedin Mobility Group AB, one of Europe’s leading vehicle importers, and Hedin Sport Car GmbH, the European distributor of Corvette, have been actively seeking a competent partner in Denmark. The choice of Corvette as a new marque at MY GARAGE is likewise driven by requests from existing customers and Danish Corvette enthusiasts for local representation.

Jan Grindemann, CEO at Hedin Sport Car, states:

“MY GARAGE Denmark has built a strong reputation for curating and representing high-performance and luxury vehicles. Corvette, known for its iconic design and thrilling performance, aligns perfectly with the passion and expertise of MY GARAGE in delivering top-tier driving experiences. The dealership’s deep understanding of the automotive world and commitment to exceptional vehicles makes it an ideal partner for representing a performance-oriented brand like Corvette.”

Lars Bjørnbak, CEO at MY GARAGE, adds:

“It is incredibly exciting to introduce a brand to Denmark that has not had official representation for five years. We have extensive experience handling niche brands and have been looking forward to adding yet another iconic marque to MY GARAGE.”

The Corvette models, which include the Stingray, Z06 and the four-wheel-drive E-Ray, have, with over 70 years of motoring history, motorsport experience and technological innovation, become a cultural phenomenon.

Since the launch of the first car in 1953, Corvette has represented the essence of the American sports car tradition. With the introduction of the E-Ray, Corvette cements its role as a pioneer in driving dynamics and groundbreaking technology.

This heritage aligns perfectly with MY GARAGE’s dedication to niche brands with deep roots, history and character. Like Lotus, Dallara and Morgan, Corvette unites tradition and innovation with a focus on driving dynamics, complementing MY GARAGE’s existing portfolio.

“Corvette adds brand value through its blend of iconic heritage, technological advancement and driving pleasure, further strengthening MY GARAGE’s position as the country’s leading automotive mecca,” concludes Mette Læssøe, PR & Marketing Executive at MY GARAGE.

With this new representation, MY GARAGE is also authorised to service and repair Corvette models from all generations. You can already experience the Corvette Stingray at MY GARAGE in Vejle.

For further information, please contact:

Mette Læssøe, PR & Marketing Executive at MY GARAGE

Telephone: +45 69 133 951

E-mail: ml@mygarage.dk

acf_post.content:
Navigating the magical world of quality wines should be straightforward and above all interesting. Wine Mage presents a new concept that has hitherto been missing from the industry.

In future you will be able to do even more to create the right atmosphere when you visit MY GARAGE. A new partner will bring knowledge and passion for wine to all visitors, and this will contribute to many fine moments. The kind where a special atmosphere arises when, in good company, you open a bottle of wine. When the scent of cork and the sweetness of the grapes direct your thoughts towards fond memories. For a moment, the stress and rush of everyday life disappears – and you find yourself right here in the present, sinking just a couple of centimetres further back into your chair. It is a moment you share – and with the right bottle of wine and some background knowledge, it is an intense experience.

MY GARAGE brings worlds together for connoisseurs

The synergies with MY GARAGE and the partners at the address are obvious, and Wine Mage will make a significant contribution in terms of supporting activities and creating awareness for the house as a whole.

MY GARAGE’s CEO Lars Bjørnbak welcomes the new partnership: – It is our foremost task to provide the framework for an outstanding experience for customers and guests in the house.

Our target audience is connoisseurs who have a sense for quality and who expect the best, whether within the automotive world or in wine. At the same time, the two companies are well matched in terms of high ambitions: Wine Mage’s objective is indeed to establish itself among the most credible and influential players in the industry. And recently we announced at MY GARAGE our ambition to grow further with more square metres, more partners and a larger business area offering the very best under one roof.

Everyone should leave Wine Mage with a richer experience

Founder of Wine Mage Per M. Pedersen explains the concept, which is based on what he believes is lacking in the industry today: – Wine Mage is a new and unique concept that has been refined and adjusted since the idea was hatched after my first visit to MY GARAGE back in 2018.

Just as is the case with MY GARAGE, every guest and customer at Wine Mage should leave with a richer experience, says Per M. Pedersen, and continues: – With a focus on quality over quantity, we look forward to exploring the magical world of wine together with our customers. At Wine Mage everyone is welcome, and we will do our utmost to ensure that everyone leaves richer for the experience, regardless of whether they have placed an order or are “simply” a guest of the house.

Wine Mage has designed a unique showroom that will serve as both a studio for video recordings and a showroom and lounge environment where tastings can take place and, above all, a place for sharing knowledge about the magical world of wine. This creates an exclusive space that is in keeping with the overall experience at MY GARAGE. With floor-to-ceiling shelving, a space is created for immersion and focus on the moment. – It should ideally feel like stepping into another world with roots going back to the wine cellar in Burgundy, says Per M. Pedersen.

Discover the magical world of exclusive wines

We expect Wine Mage to open the doors to their new showroom at MY GARAGE at the end of 2022.

For further information and interest regarding Wine Mage, please contact founder Per M. Pedersen.

acf_post.heading: MY GARAGE becomes official dealer of Praga
acf_post.content:
MY GARAGE expands its exclusive portfolio of high-performance brands and becomes the official Nordic dealer of Praga, one of the world’s oldest and most traditional performance brands.

Praga was founded in 1907 and has developed everything from passenger cars and racing cars to aircraft and advanced technological solutions for more than a century. Throughout its long history, the brand has built a special position in the automotive world, where motorsport heritage and technical innovation remain central values.

Today, Praga is particularly known for its expertise in lightweight construction and aerodynamics. This approach has made the brand a respected player in both motorsport and the modern hypercar segment.

A natural match for MY GARAGE

MY GARAGE works purposefully to represent some of the most interesting and exclusive brands in the international automotive world. Praga fits naturally into this ambition with its focus on uncompromising engineering and a pure driving experience.

“Praga represents exactly the type of brand we want to bring together at MY GARAGE. It is a brand with an authentic history and strong motorsport roots, while also challenging the boundaries of modern performance. Praga offers something very special that we are convinced will appeal to the passionate car enthusiasts and collectors who come to our house,” says Dennis Stendorph, Sales Executive at MY GARAGE.

“In our search for the right partner, MY GARAGE stood out immediately. Beyond a shared passion for high-performance supercars, we are aligned in our commitment to exclusivity, personal relationships, and building a strong community around our brands. We are confident that Praga will be a valuable addition to MY GARAGE’s exceptional portfolio and that together we can unlock exciting new opportunities for the future,” says Ivan Krakora, Chief Sales and Marketing Officer at Praga.

Praga Bohema

As part of the collaboration, MY GARAGE can now present Praga Bohema, the brand’s modern flagship and one of the most uncompromising hypercars on the market.

The Bohema is designed to deliver race car-like performance on the track, while being fully usable on the public road. The car is based on the philosophy that has characterized Praga for generations, where low weight and efficient aerodynamics are crucial elements.

Despite its uncompromising performance focus, the Bohema offers an exclusive and comfortable interior with handcrafted details, tailored solutions and space for two people. Each car is hand-assembled under extensive quality control and represents the culmination of more than 100 years of experience in motorsport, construction and aerodynamics.

With the addition of Praga, MY GARAGE strengthens its position as a destination for some of the world’s most exciting performance cars and gives Danish enthusiasts access to a brand with a very special history.

  • 3.8-liter twin-turbo V6 engine developed in collaboration with Litchfield Engineering
  • 700 hp and 725 Nm
  • Weight of only 982 kg
  • 0-100 km/h in 2.3 seconds
  • Top speed of 317 km/h
  • More than 900 kg of downforce at 250 km/h
  • Carbon fiber monocoque and extensive use of lightweight materials
  • Hewland 6-speed sequential gearbox
  • Approved for both track and road use
  • Production limited to 89 examples worldwide.

acf_post.heading: Luxury car makes
acf_post.content:
When talking about cars that are something out of the ordinary, the conversation quickly turns to the great luxury car makes. These are manufacturers with a long history of producing vehicles that combine exclusivity, craftsmanship and performance at the very highest level.

A world of refined driving pleasure

Luxury car makes represent the absolute pinnacle of automotive engineering. Whether you dream of a Rolls-Royce, a Bentley, a Porsche or a Lotus, these are cars that offer an experience far beyond simple transportation.

At MY GARAGE, we have a carefully curated selection of the world’s finest luxury cars – both for sale and for leasing. We are passionate about exclusive cars and take pride in offering our customers an extraordinary experience.

Rolls-Royce – the epitome of luxury

Rolls-Royce is synonymous with the ultimate in luxury and exclusivity. Every car is handcrafted to the highest standards, and the attention to detail is unparalleled. A Rolls-Royce is not just a car – it is a statement.

Porsche – performance meets elegance

Porsche has for decades represented a perfect blend of sports car performance and everyday usability. From the iconic 911 to the versatile Cayenne, Porsche offers a broad range of vehicles for the discerning driver.

Lotus – the art of lightweight engineering

Lotus is a British manufacturer with a philosophy centred on lightweight construction and driving dynamics. A Lotus is a car for true driving enthusiasts – precise, agile and thrilling to drive.

Morgan – a timeless classic

Morgan is a unique British manufacturer that has remained true to its heritage of handcrafted, traditional sports cars. A Morgan is a car with genuine character and an unmistakable presence on the road.

Find your luxury car at MY GARAGE

At MY GARAGE, we offer a wide selection of luxury cars from the world’s most prestigious manufacturers. Whether you are looking to buy or lease, we can help you find exactly the right car.

Contact us today and let us help you find your dream car.

groupColumn.column:
Has it always been a dream to own a Lotus? At MY GARAGE we will do everything we can to help make that dream a reality. Owning a Lotus is like owning a piece of a racing team – almost. The models from Lotus share all the same advantages as the cars that compete in Formula 1 or other motorsport classes. The cars’ design is both sporty and distinctive, and they drive superbly. We are happy to help you find exactly the right model for you.

We help you with leasing your new Lotus

We do not offer standard solutions. Both our cars and our customers are entirely unique, and that calls for tailored solutions suited to each individual’s needs. Once we have found the right car for you, we are ready to advise you on how to finance your new car. We give you an overview of our leasing options and guide you in the right direction. There are, after all, many advantages to leasing your new Lotus through us:

Contact us today to find out more about the possibilities.

What is the advantage of leasing a Lotus rather than buying it?

It is no secret that you own a car when you buy it. This means that you have full control over the car, but also that you are personally responsible for all costs. The advantage of leasing a Lotus rather than buying it may be that you are not personally responsible for all maintenance and servicing, which is often included in a leasing agreement. For many, leasing is a straightforward arrangement where you simply pay a monthly instalment to have the car at your disposal.

Leasing is also an excellent solution for those who do not wish to keep the same car for several years. When you lease a Lotus, a leasing period is agreed, after which you can either extend it or return the car and lease a new model instead. At the same time, you avoid the major financial decision that buying a car can represent. When your leasing period ends, there is no outstanding finance to settle.

Which luxury Lotus cars can be leased?

At MY GARAGE we are ready to help you find exactly the right Lotus for you. It could be a Lotus Elise, which is one of Lotus’ most iconic models. If you prefer the sporty and distinctive appearance, we are also happy to help you find the right Lotus Evora. You may also be after a hard-top model, in which case we can recommend the Lotus Exige.

seo.title: What is leasing? - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: What is leasing? - MY GARAGE

acf_post.heading: What is leasing?
acf_post.content:
When you are considering acquiring a new car, there are broadly two options: you can buy the car or you can lease it. But what is leasing, and is it the right solution for you?

On this page, we explain what leasing is and outline the different types of leasing available, so you can more easily find the solution that best matches your needs.

What does leasing mean?

Leasing is a form of long-term rental where you pay for the right to use a car over a set period. You do not own the car, but you have it at your disposal throughout the agreed lease period. At the end of the period, you return the car to the leasing company.

With leasing, you pay an initial instalment and a fixed monthly amount. The monthly payment is determined by factors such as the value of the car, the lease period and the agreed mileage allowance.

The different types of leasing

There are several types of leasing, each suited to different needs and circumstances. The most common types include private leasing, business leasing, operational leasing, financial leasing and flex leasing.

Private leasing is for private individuals who wish to drive a new car without purchasing it outright. Business leasing is for companies that wish to provide cars for their employees. Operational leasing includes a service agreement, while financial leasing is more similar to a hire purchase arrangement. Flex leasing offers greater flexibility with no fixed lease period.

The advantages of leasing

There are many advantages to leasing a car. You avoid the large outlay associated with buying a car, and you have a clear, fixed monthly cost. Leasing also gives you the opportunity to drive a newer and more expensive car than you might otherwise be able to afford, and you can upgrade to a new model at the end of the lease period.

Is leasing the right choice for you?

Whether leasing is the right solution for you depends on your individual situation and needs. If you drive a fixed number of kilometres each year and prefer financial predictability, leasing may well be an excellent choice.

seo.title: Is leasing worth it? - MY GARAGE
seo.opengraphTitle: Is leasing worth it? - MY GARAGE

acf_landing_page.search: Kan det betale sig at lease?

groupColumn.column:
More and more people are choosing leasing over buying a car, and the significant growth in the leasing market indicates that leasing is a sound choice. But when does leasing actually make financial sense in practice?

It is difficult to compare leasing directly against buying a car and arrive at a clear-cut answer as to which is better. It all depends on a wide range of factors, which we will explore in more detail on this page.

Advantages and disadvantages of leasing versus buying

As with everything, there are both advantages and disadvantages to buying and leasing, but your choice will often become clear once you gain a better understanding of the various parameters, which typically relate to your finances, your driving habits and your requirements for the car. In this way, you arrive at the approach that best suits your individual needs.

Are you acquiring a new car because you intend to keep it for the next six years, or do you prefer to change your car after a couple of years? When you buy your car and therefore own it, you can decide for yourself how long to keep it before selling. If, on the other hand, you enjoy changing your car frequently for something new, then leasing is almost certainly the right solution. In most leasing arrangements, it is a requirement that you change the car every two or three years.

Do you have a long commute, and do you often take extended weekend trips away? When you lease a car, your contract will include a mileage limit, which is very costly to exceed. When you own the car, you can drive as many kilometres as you wish — and therefore leasing makes the most sense if you do not cover large distances.

When you choose to buy a car rather than lease, you are responsible for the cost of service and maintenance once the warranty period has expired. You never quite know what to expect, but in the worst case it can mean many unforeseen expenses. When you lease, you are covered by the warranty throughout the entire period, meaning you also have a clear picture of your outgoings for the full term. It is also possible to take out a return insurance policy, so you do not have to pay for any external damage when the leasing period ends.

When does leasing make sense?

Are you anticipating changes in your personal life, or are you in a stable position with regard to employment and housing? These are factors that determine whether leasing makes sense for you. Under a leasing agreement, you have considerably more flexibility than you do when you own a car and bear full responsibility for disposing of it again at the best possible price. Is leasing right for you? Contact us at MY GARAGE to hear about your options.

acf_post.heading: Operational leasing
acf_post.content:
If you are considering leasing a car, operational leasing may well be the right solution for you. Operational leasing can be an excellent option if you are interested in driving an exclusive car and having the ability to return the car at the end of the lease period.

On this page, you can find out a great deal more about what operational leasing is and what this form of leasing entails. Read on here and get help assessing whether operational leasing is the right choice for you.

What is operational leasing?

Operational leasing is a form of leasing in which you rent a vehicle for a lease period, after which the car can be returned to the lessor. Throughout the entire lease period, the leasing company covers all running costs, as a service agreement is attached as part of the arrangement. This gives you greater certainty regarding your budget, as the service agreement typically covers workshop visits and replenishment of oil, screen wash and similar items for the car. In this way, it is also the most risk-free form of leasing, and therefore usually also the most expensive.

With operational leasing, a one-off amount is paid upon delivery of the car, and then a monthly amount is paid for the leasing of the car throughout the lease period.

At the end of the lease period, you do not own the car and you have no obligations in connection with it. The car is simply returned to the leasing company.

Is flex leasing the same as operational leasing?

Flex leasing is not operational leasing, but rather financial leasing. When you choose flex leasing (financial leasing), the leasing works almost like a form of purchasing a car on hire purchase, whereas operational leasing (private leasing) is a rental of the car.

How is operational leasing recorded in the accounts?

Operational leasing is recorded under operating costs in your profit and loss account, as you are renting a product. With operational leasing, the lease payment is tax-deductible, and you therefore receive a deduction for your car expenses. There is no VAT outlay on the acquisition cost.

Do you dream of driving a supercar with all the best equipment, providing you with high levels of comfort and an exceptional driving experience every time? Are you unsure whether operational leasing is the right choice for you? Do not hesitate to contact us on +45 69 13 39 11 or by email at info@mygarage.dk. The Morgan Plus Four 75th anniversary model from 2025 is a tribute to one of Morgan's most iconic models, which first saw the light of day in 1950.
